```typescript
type MobState = {
  id: number;                    // unique per-session ID
  kind: MobKind;                 // "sheep" | "chicken" | "horse" | "zombie" | "skeleton" | "spider"
  hostile: boolean;              // passive vs aggressive
  hp: number;                    // current health (dies at <= 0)
  position: THREE.Vector3;       // body center (ground + halfHeight)
  direction: THREE.Vector3;      // facing direction (normalized XZ)
  yaw: number;                   // derived from direction each tick
  turnTimer: number;             // countdown to next random turn
  speed: number;                 // base movement speed (from template)
  moveSpeed: number;             // actual speed this tick (after aggro/flee multipliers: 1.15x)
  detectRange: number;           // aggro distance (0 for passive, 10-12 for hostiles)
  attackDamage: number;          // damage per hit
  attackCooldown: number;        // seconds between attacks
  attackTimer: number;           // countdown to next attack
  halfHeight: number;            // body center height above ground
  bobSeed: number;               // animation seed
  fedTimer: number;              // seconds "in love" after feeding
  ageTimer: number;              // baby timer (> 0 = baby, scaled down)
};
```

**Mob Update Loop** (`tickMobs`, lines 23-102):
1. Decrement `attackTimer` and `turnTimer` by `dt`
2. Calculate horizontal/3D distance to player
3. Determine `activeHostile` state (hostile + day/night rules)
4. **Behavior Selection**:
   - If hostile + in detect range: chase player (direction lerp 20% per frame)
   - Else if passive + nearby (< 4.2): flee player
   - Else if turnTimer <= 0: random turn + reset timer (1.5-5.5s)
5. Apply movement: `position.x/z += direction * moveSpeed * dt`
6. Clamp to world bounds (bounce at edges)
7. Update Y position from terrain (`surfaceYAt`)
8. Update yaw from direction
9. Check line-of-sight (raycast) for attack eligibility
10. **Attack if eligible** (all conditions met + timer ready)

### 8. ENGINE SIMULATION STEP ORDER

**File: `/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/david/monecraft/lib/game/engine/GameEngine.ts` (lines 171-220)**

**Full Step Sequence** (when not dead/paused/sleeping):
1. `tickPlayerMotion()` - physics, ground check, velocity
2. `tickHungerDrain()` - consume hunger from movement
3. `tickHealthRegen()` - restore health if fed enough
4. `tickMining()` - block breaking progress
5. `tickDayNight()` - advance day clock
6. `tickWeather()` - update weather state
7. `tickRandomBlocks()` - crop growth
8. `tickHostileSpawnDirector()` - spawn/despawn ambient mobs
9. `tickSpawnerDirector()` - dungeon spawner activation
10. **`tickMobs()`** - ALL mob AI (movement, attacks, line-of-sight)
11. `tickBreeding()` - animal breeding logic
12. Debug HUD update

**Key Ordering Notes**:
- Combat happens AFTER player motion (so knockback affects frame)
- Mobs process AFTER spawning (newly spawned mobs can attack same frame)
- Health regen happens BEFORE combat (so regen can be interrupted by damage)
- No invulnerability frames (damage applied immediately, every frame mob is in range)

```
The plan is written. Here is the complete file-by-file implementation plan for the endgame & ranged combat feature.

## Summary

I read and verified every file the prompt referenced (plus the world raycast API, the React shell, audio director, sprite/extrusion code, and all five exhaustive `Record<MobKind>` sites). The established facts all checked out. Key findings that shaped the design:

- **No `stick` item exists** — arrow recipe uses wood + feather + stone instead.
- **Combat is command-driven** (`dispatch({type:"attack"})`), not per-frame — so bow firing branches inside the existing `attack` case, no new command needed.
- **A new `MobKind` "boss" forces edits in exactly 5 exhaustive tables**: `MOB_TEMPLATES`, `MOB_DROPS`, `CALL_INTERVALS`, `MOB_AMBIENT_SOUNDS`, `MOB_ATTACK_SOUNDS`. `soundParams.test.ts` iterates `Object.keys(MOB_TEMPLATES)`, so all three sound/template tables must stay in lockstep. The `mobDied` particle path reads `MOB_TEMPLATES[event.kind].modelArgs[0]`, so the boss needs a valid template.
- **`voxelRaycast` already does swept DDA** against `world.isSolid` — reuse it for arrow-vs-block, then substep the *entity* test to stop fast arrows tunneling thin mobs.
- **Snapshot bridge is ref-diffed** in `refreshSnapshot()` — a naive per-tick `boss` object would re-render React every frame, so the plan reuses the prior reference unless the rounded HP percent changes. `PRE_MOUNT_SNAPSHOT` in `useMinecraftGame.ts` must mirror any new `GameSnapshot` field.

## Key design decisions

- **One shared transient projectile system** (`ProjectileState[]` on `GameState`, `tickProjectiles` after `tickMobs`) with a `fromPlayer` hit filter — used by the bow, skeletons, and the boss. Not serialized, consistent with mobs.
- **Instant-click-fire, not charge-and-release** — justified by the discrete single-command input model; charge would require new continuous-input plumbing that conflicts with hold-to-mine.
- **Boss gated behind a craftable Cursed Totem** (diamond + bone + gold), right-click to summon via the injected seeded RNG, refuses if a boss exists. Drops a Dragon Heart → crafts the ultimate Dragon Sword. No new worldgen structures.
- **No save/version bump**: new items are additive (saved by string id); projectiles, boss, minions, victory flag are all transient.

The full plan (config tunables, exact ITEM_DEFS/recipes, sprite grids, the substepping math, the boss health-bar + victory-screen components, the test matrix confirming worldgen hash stability, doc/CHANGELOG updates, risks, and a 6-commit slicing) is written to:
```

26	## 1. Projectile system (the shared core)
27	
28	### 1a. ProjectileState type + GameState slot
29	New file `lib/game/engine/projectiles.ts` (pure type + helpers, no Three rendering):
30	```
31	export type ProjectileState = {
32	  id: number;
33	  position: THREE.Vector3;   // current center
34	  velocity: THREE.Vector3;   // m/s, gravity-integrated
35	  yaw: number; pitch: number; // derived from velocity each step for the renderer
36	  damage: number;
37	  knockback: number;
38	  fromPlayer: boolean;       // hit filter: player arrows hit mobs; mob/boss arrows hit player
39	  ttl: number;               // seconds remaining
40	};
41	```
42	Add to `GameState` (state.ts): `projectiles: ProjectileState[]` and `nextProjectileId: number`. Initialize `projectiles: []`, `nextProjectileId: 1` in GameEngine constructor. **Transient** — never serialized (mirrors mobs).
43	
44	Spawn helper (in projectiles.ts):
45	```
46	export function spawnArrow(state, originX, originY, originZ, dir: THREE.Vector3, opts: {speed, damage, knockback, fromPlayer, ttl}): void
47	```
48	Sets velocity = dir.normalized * speed (single shared launch path used by player firing, skeletons, and boss).
49	
50	### 1b. tickProjectiles(state, dt, deps) — new system file `lib/game/engine/systems/projectileAI.ts`
51	Deps: `{ applyDamage:(amount:number)=>void, removeMobAt:(index:number)=>void, rng:()=>number, emit:EmitGameEvent }` (reuse the engine's existing closures via `mobTickDeps`-style getter; pass a thin subset). Per projectile:
52	1. Decrement ttl; if `<=0` despawn (emit `arrowExpired`/no event, just splice).
53	2. **Substepped integration to prevent tunneling**: compute `speed = velocity.length()`; choose `substeps = clamp(ceil(speed*dt / MAX_SEGMENT), 1, ARROW_MAX_SUBSTEPS)` where MAX_SEGMENT≈0.5 block. For each substep with `sdt = dt/substeps`:
54	   - Apply gravity: `velocity.y -= ARROW_GRAVITY * sdt`.
55	   - Compute `next = position + velocity*sdt`. Build segment dir/len.
56	   - **Block collision (swept)**: `voxelRaycast(world, position, segDir, segLen)`; if hit within segLen → stick/despawn at `hit.distance` point, emit `arrowHit` (block variant), stop. (Use the existing DDA — handles thin/fast arrows along the segment.)
57	   - **Entity collision (swept, capsule-ish via point-segment distance to mob center)**: iterate candidates and test min distance from the moving point's segment to the target's vertical cylinder. For `fromPlayer` arrows → test `state.mobs` (skip the firing skeleton's own arrows hitting skeletons? No — friendly fire OK and adds depth; keep simple: hit any mob). For `!fromPlayer` arrows → test the player AABB (use `PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH`/`PLAYER_HEIGHT` around `player.position`, hit radius ARROW_HIT_RADIUS + half-width). On hit:
58	     - Player arrow → `mob.hp -= damage`; knockback like `tryAttackMob` (push mob along arrow dir, small +y); if `mob.hp<=0` collect index for `removeMobAt`; emit `mobHit`+`arrowHit`(mob). Reuse death path (drops via removeMobAt).
59	     - Mob/boss arrow → `deps.applyDamage(damage)` (armor-mitigated, emits playerHurt/died); apply horizontal knockback to `player.velocity` like the melee path; emit `arrowHit`(player). Despawn.
60	   - Update `position = next` if no collision.
61	3. After move: set `yaw = atan2(velocity.x, velocity.z)`, `pitch = asin(velocity.y/|v|)` for renderer orientation.
62	4. Cull projectiles leaving world bounds (x/z < 1 or > size-1, or y<0) → despawn.
63	Remove dead projectiles by reverse-index splice (same pattern as deadIndices in mobAI).
64	
65	### 1c. Placement in engine step order
66	Insert `tickProjectiles(state, dt, this.projectileTickDeps)` **immediately after `tickMobs`** (so mobs/boss spawn their arrows this tick, then arrows that already exist advance; new arrows fly next tick — acceptable 1-frame latency, deterministic). Order: ...spawnerDirector → tickMobs → **tickProjectiles** → breeding. Run it in the `isDead` branch too? No — when dead, the player can't be hit further; but boss/skeleton arrows in flight can keep flying harmlessly. Simplest deterministic choice: also tick projectiles in the dead branch (after tickMobs) so they expire/clear; they just can't damage a dead player (applyDamageWithArmor early-returns on isDead). Mirror the dead-branch `tickMobs` call.
67	
68	### 1d. Substepping rationale
69	Arrows at ~32 m/s × 0.05 s = 1.6 blocks/step — would skip 1-block walls and thin mobs. Swept block raycast already covers walls; for entities the point could still jump past a thin mob between frames, so substep the *entity* test too (segment-distance per substep). Cap substeps (ARROW_MAX_SUBSTEPS=4) to bound cost. The renderer interpolation is not needed (50ms steps are fine visually).

Call `spawnArrow(... fromPlayer:true, speed:ARROW_SPEED, damage:BOW_ARROW_DAMAGE, knockback, ttl:ARROW_TTL)`. Consume 1 `arrow` (`adjustSlotCount(inventory,"arrow",-1)`), wear bow (`consumeToolDurability(inventory, selectedSlot, 1)`), set a cooldown timer, emit `bowFired`.

85	Cooldown: add `bowCooldownTimer` to `GameTimers` (state.ts) + `createTimers`; decremented in GameEngine.step (a one-liner before the attack branch is dispatch-only, so instead decrement in step() each frame: `state.timers.bowCooldownTimer = Math.max(0, ... - dt)`). The `attack` case checks `tryFireBow` first:
86	```
87	case "attack":
88	  if (dead/inventoryOpen/sleeping) break;
89	  this.emit({type:"attackSwung"});       // keep the swing anim for bow too
90	  if (isBow(selectedSlot)) { if (tryFireBow(...)) {/* fired */} break; }  // bow never melees
91	  const hitKind = tryAttackMob(...); ... (unchanged melee path)
92	```
93	
94	**Recommendation: instant-click-fire (NOT charge-and-release).** Justification: the input model is a single `attack` command emitted on left-click (mining holds left for blocks, but combat is a discrete click via the input controller). There is no existing "hold-to-charge then release" channel into the engine — charge would require new continuous-input plumbing (FrameInput already has `leftMouseHeld`, but attack is dispatched discretely, and adding charge state risks conflict with hold-to-mine). Instant-fire with a fixed `BOW_COOLDOWN` (≈0.4 s) gives a clean, deterministic, well-tested path and a satisfying fire rate. Damage is fixed (no charge multiplier). This keeps determinism and the single-command surface intact.

99	
100	Differentiate skeletons (ranged) from zombies (melee) inside `tickMobs`. Add a per-kind flag — cleanest: a `ranged?: boolean` field on `MobTemplate` (mobs.ts) set true for skeleton + boss; read into a local `isRanged` (no MobState change needed since it's derivable from `MOB_TEMPLATES[mob.kind].ranged`, but to avoid a per-tick lookup, optionally copy onto MobState at spawn — prefer the template lookup to avoid widening MobState/SavedSlot).

102	Behavior changes for ranged mobs in the aggro branch:
103	- **Standoff/kiting**: when `distanceToPlayer < SKELETON_STANDOFF_MIN` (too close), invert the approach direction (back away) instead of advancing; between MIN and `mob.detectRange`, strafe/hold. Keep facing the player (`mob.direction` toward player for aim, but movement uses the standoff vector). Implement: compute desired move = away if `dist<STANDOFF_MIN`, toward if `dist>STANDOFF_MAX`, else 0 (hold). Aim direction stays toward player.
104	- **Firing**: replace the melee block for ranged mobs. When `activeHostile && dist < detectRange && verticalGap < SKELETON_FIRE_VGAP && lineOfSight && attackTimer<=0`: compute aim from mob eye (`position.y + halfHeight*0.7`) to player chest (`player.position.y + 0.9`). Optional simple **lead**: add `player.velocity * (dist/ARROW_SPEED) * SKELETON_LEAD_FACTOR` to the target point (deterministic, uses existing velocity). Normalize → `spawnArrow(... fromPlayer:false, speed:ARROW_SPEED*0.8, damage:SKELETON_ARROW_DAMAGE, ttl:ARROW_TTL)`. Set `mob.attackTimer = mob.attackCooldown` (reuse). Emit `mobAttacked` (drives existing skeleton attack sound). LoS reuse: extend the existing `voxelRaycast` LoS check radius to `detectRange` for ranged mobs (currently gated by `attackDistance<4`).
105	- **Zombies unchanged**: `ranged` undefined → existing melee `attackDistance<4` path runs as-is.
106	Skeleton template tweaks (mobs.ts): keep hp 9; set `ranged:true`; `attackDamage` becomes the arrow damage source (or use SKELETON_ARROW_DAMAGE from config and ignore template attackDamage for ranged). `attackCooldown` ≈ 1.6–2.0 (kite cadence). detectRange 12 stays.

Spawn the boss with `pushMob`... however `pushMob` is in spawnDirector.ts and not exported. **Export `pushMob`** (or add `spawnBoss(state, x,y,z, rng)` wrapper) from spawnDirector.ts and import in interact.ts. Every BOSS_SUMMON_INTERVAL while boss aggro'd and minion count < BOSS_MINION_CAP and global HOSTILE_CAP not exceeded → `pushMob(... "skeleton"/"zombie")` near boss; emit `mobSpawned`. The engine sets a `state.victory = true` flag (new GameState field, session-only, NOT serialized) so the snapshot can show the victory screen persistently. 231	- **No version bump, no SAVE_KEY change.** `serialize()` stays version 5 / minecraft_save_v6.

No migration needed. `tryInsertSlots`/`restoreInventorySlots` already drop unknown ids gracefully — but since defs are additive and shipped together, ids are always known going forward.

276	## 11. Risks, edge cases, commit slicing
277	
278	### Risks / edge cases
279	- **MobKind exhaustiveness**: adding `"boss"` breaks compile until all 5 Records updated + soundParams.test passes. Do this atomically in the boss commit.
280	- **Snapshot churn**: a naive per-tick `boss` object re-renders React every frame — must reuse the prev reference unless rounded percent changes (see 5f). Same care for `victory`.
281	- **PRE_MOUNT_SNAPSHOT**: forgetting `boss`/`victory` there is a type error — add together with the GameSnapshot fields.
282	- **HOSTILE_CAP starvation**: boss + minions vs the global cap of 16 — ensure boss spawn isn't blocked by cap (summon bypasses the director cap; minion summon respects BOSS_MINION_CAP and checks global cap but boss must not be culled).
283	- **Friendly fire / self-hit**: a mob's own arrow could collide with its source the instant it spawns. Spawn arrows slightly ahead of the muzzle (origin + dir*0.6) and/or skip the first substep's entity test against the firer. Player arrows spawned at eye won't hit the player (fromPlayer filter excludes player).
284	- **Determinism**: all randomness (summon placement, minion choice, spread jitter if any) uses the injected engine `rng` / seeded RNG — never `Math.random` in sim code.
285	- **Dead-player branch**: ensure tickProjectiles runs (or is safely skipped) in the isDead branch so in-flight arrows clear; applyDamageWithArmor already no-ops while dead.
286	- **Bow melee=0**: bow has `attack:0`; ensure the attack branch returns after `tryFireBow` so bow never falls into `tryAttackMob` (which would melee for FIST_DAMAGE via weaponDamage's `?? 8`? No — weaponDamage returns `slot.attack ?? 8`, so attack:0 → 0; but cleaner to branch out entirely).
287	- **arrow as `material`**: confirm `consumeToolDurability` is only called on the bow slot, not the arrow stack.
288

290	1. `feat(projectiles): add transient projectile state, system, and config` — ProjectileState, spawnArrow, tickProjectiles, step-order wiring, config tunables, projectiles + projectileAI tests. (No items yet; test via direct spawnArrow.)
291	2. `feat(combat): craftable bow and arrows with click-to-fire` — bow/arrow ITEM_DEFS + recipes + sprites, `tryFireBow`, attack-branch wiring, bowCooldown timer, combat/recipe/sprite tests.
292	3. `feat(mobs): skeletons fire arrows and kite` — MobTemplate.ranged, mobAI standoff+fire branch, skeleton template, mobAI tests. (Reuses projectile system.)
293	4. `feat(render+audio): in-flight arrows and ranged sounds` — projectileVisuals + GameRenderer wiring, arrowHit/bowFired particles+sounds, projectileVisuals test.
294	5. `feat(boss): endgame boss, summon totem, and victory` — boss MobKind (+all 5 Records), boss template/drops/sounds, summon flow in interact (+export pushMob/spawnBoss), boss AI (melee+ranged+minions), bossDefeated→victory, GameState victory + snapshot boss bridge, BossHealthBar + VictoryScreen components, MinecraftGame wiring, dragon_heart/dragon_sword item+recipe+sprite, engine tests.
295	6. `docs: endgame & ranged combat` — CHANGELOG [Unreleased] + docs updates.
296	
297	(Commits 5 is the largest; if needed split into 5a "boss mob + summon + AI" and 5b "victory UI + reward gear".)

```
1	import * as THREE from "three";
2	import { ATTACK_AIM_DOT, ATTACK_REACH, EYE_HEIGHT, FIST_DAMAGE } from "@/lib/game/config";
3	import type { MobKind } from "@/lib/game/types";
4	import type { GameState } from "../state";
5	import { lookDirection } from "./playerMotion";
6	
7	const scratchForward = new THREE.Vector3();
8	const scratchOrigin = new THREE.Vector3();
9	const scratchToMob = new THREE.Vector3();
10	const scratchKnock = new THREE.Vector3();
11	
12	export function weaponDamage(state: GameState): number {
13	  const slot = state.inventory[state.selectedSlot];
14	  if (slot?.kind === "weapon" && slot.count > 0) return slot.attack ?? 8;
15	  return FIST_DAMAGE;
16	}
17	
18	/**
19	 * Index of the mob nearest the crosshair within melee reach and aim cone, or
20	 * -1. Shared by attacking and by feeding animals (Phase 5) so both use the same
21	 * "what am I pointing at" rule.
22	 */
23	export function findAimedMobIndex(state: GameState): number {
24	  const { position } = state.player;
25	  scratchOrigin.set(position.x, position.y + EYE_HEIGHT, position.z);
26	  lookDirection(state.player.yaw, state.player.pitch, scratchForward);
27	
28	  let bestIndex = -1;
29	  let bestDist = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
30	
31	  for (let i = 0; i < state.mobs.length; i += 1) {
32	    const mob = state.mobs[i];
33	    scratchToMob.copy(mob.position).sub(scratchOrigin);
34	    const dist = scratchToMob.length();
35	    if (dist > ATTACK_REACH) continue;
36	    scratchToMob.normalize();
37	    if (scratchForward.dot(scratchToMob) < ATTACK_AIM_DOT) continue;
38	    if (dist < bestDist) {
39	      bestDist = dist;
40	      bestIndex = i;
41	    }
42	  }
43	  return bestIndex;
44	}
45	
46	/**
47	 * Melee attack at the mob nearest the crosshair within reach. Returns the kind
48	 * of the mob hit (or null); the caller (engine) handles death drops and durability.
49	 */
50	export function tryAttackMob(state: GameState, damage: number, onMobKilled: (index: number) => void): MobKind | null {
51	  const { position } = state.player;
52	  const bestIndex = findAimedMobIndex(state);
53	  if (bestIndex < 0) return null;
54	  const mob = state.mobs[bestIndex];
55	  mob.hp -= damage;
56	
57	  scratchKnock.copy(mob.position).sub(position).setY(0);
58	  if (scratchKnock.lengthSq() > 0.0001) {
59	    scratchKnock.normalize();
60	    mob.direction.copy(scratchKnock);
61	    mob.position.addScaledVector(scratchKnock, 0.75);
62	    mob.position.y += 0.12;
63	  }
64	
65	  if (mob.hp <= 0) onMobKilled(bestIndex);
66	  return mob.kind;
67	}
68
```

> AGENT

The plan is written. Here's the summary of what I'm proposing.

## Endgame & Ranged Combat — my take

The smart move here is that **all three parts ride on one new piece of infrastructure**: a transient projectile system. Build that once, and the bow, ranged skeletons, and the boss's attacks all reuse it. That's what keeps a feature this big to ~650 LoC.

**What gets built (one branch, per your choices):**
1. **Projectile system** — a new `ProjectileState[]` on `GameState`, `spawnArrow` helper, and `tickProjectiles` running right after `tickMobs`. Swept block collision reuses the existing `voxelRaycast` DDA; substepping the entity test stops fast arrows tunneling through thin mobs/walls. A `fromPlayer` flag filters who each arrow can hit.
2. **Bow + arrows** — instant click-to-fire branching off the existing `attack` command (no new input plumbing, deterministic). Consumes an arrow, wears the bow, short cooldown.
3. **Ranged skeletons** — a `ranged` template flag turns skeletons into kiting archers (standoff + lead-aim), finally distinguishing them from zombies. Zombies stay melee.
4. **Boss + win** — a craftable diamond-gated **Cursed Totem** summons the boss (no worldgen change); high HP, 3-arrow spread + melee + minion summons; killing it drops a **Dragon Heart** → crafts the best-in-game **Dragon Sword**, fires a one-time victory screen, and shows a boss health bar while alive.

**Why it stays clean:** no save-format or worldgen bump — projectiles/boss are transient (mobs already aren't persisted) and new items are additive by id. The one sharp edge is the new `"boss"` `MobKind`, which forces edits across 5 exhaustive `Record<MobKind>` tables atomically; the plan flags that and the snapshot-churn risk (reuse the boss snapshot ref unless HP% changes).

The full file-by-file breakdown, config tunables, test matrix, and a 6-commit slicing are in the plan file. Ready for your review.

Projectile system (shared core)\n\n**New `lib/game/engine/projectiles.ts`** — pure type + spawn helper, no Three.js:\n- `ProjectileState = { id, position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3, yaw, pitch, damage, knockback, fromPlayer: boolean, ttl }`.\n- `spawnArrow(state, originX, originY, originZ, dir, { speed, damage, knockback, fromPlayer, ttl })` — normalizes `dir * speed` into velocity, assigns `id` from `state.nextProjectileId++`, pushes to `state.projectiles`. Single launch path used by bow, skeletons, and boss. Spawn the origin slightly ahead of the muzzle (`origin + dir*0.6`) so the firer never self-hits.\n\n**`lib/game/engine/state.ts`** — add `projectiles: ProjectileState[]` and `nextProjectileId: number` to `GameState` (init `[]` / `1` in the GameEngine constructor). **Transient — never added to `SaveData` / `serialize()`.**\n\n**New `lib/game/engine/systems/projectileAI.ts`** — `tickProjectiles(state, dt, deps)` where `deps = { applyDamage, removeMobAt, emit }` (subset of the existing engine closures used by `tickMobs`). Per projectile:\n1. `ttl -= dt`; despawn if `<= 0`.\n2. **Substepped integration** (anti-tunneling): `substeps = clamp(ceil(speed*dt / ARROW_MAX_SEGMENT), 1, ARROW_MAX_SUBSTEPS)`. Per substep (`sdt = dt/substeps`): apply gravity (`velocity.y -= ARROW_GRAVITY*sdt`), compute the segment, then:\n   - **Block hit (swept):** reuse `voxelRaycast(world, position, segDir, segLen)` (existing DDA over `world.isSolid`). If it hits within the segment → despawn at the hit point, `emit({type:\"arrowHit\", ...point})`, stop.\n   - **Entity hit (swept):** point-to-segment distance against target vertical cylinders. `fromPlayer` arrows test `state.mobs`; non-player arrows test the player AABB (`PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH`/height around `player.position`). On mob hit: `mob.hp -= damage` + knockback along arrow dir (mirror the `tryAttackMob` knockback in `combat.ts:57-63`), collect index for `removeMobAt` if dead, `emit mobHit + arrowHit`. On player hit: `deps.applyDamage(damage)` (armor-mitigated via existing `applyDamageWithArmor`) + horizontal knockback to `player.velocity`, `emit arrowHit`. Despawn on any entity hit.\n   - Else advance `position`.\n3. Set `yaw = atan2(velocity.x, velocity.z)`, `pitch = asin(velocity.y/|v|)` for the renderer.\n4. Cull out-of-bounds (x/z outside world, y<0). Remove dead by reverse-index splice (same pattern as `mobAI.ts` deadIndices).\n\n**`lib/game/engine/GameEngine.ts`** — call `tickProjectiles` **immediately after `tickMobs`** in both the live and `isDead` step branches (so in-flight arrows always clear; `applyDamageWithArmor` already no-ops while dead). Decrement the bow cooldown timer each frame here too.\n\n**Anti-tunneling rationale:** ~34 m/s × 0.05 s ≈ 1.7 blocks/step would skip thin walls/mobs. The swept block raycast covers walls; substepping the entity test (cap 4) covers thin mobs at bounded cost.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Player firing — instant click-to-fire\n\nNo new command — reuse `attack`. In **`lib/game/engine/systems/combat.ts`** add:\n- `isBow(slot)` → `slot?.id === \"bow\" && count > 0`.\n- `tryFireBow(state, deps)` → false if not bow / no `arrow` in inventory / `bowCooldownTimer > 0`. Else: origin = eye (`position.y + EYE_HEIGHT`), dir = `lookDirection(yaw, pitch)`, call `spawnArrow(... fromPlayer:true, speed:ARROW_SPEED, damage:BOW_ARROW_DAMAGE, ttl:ARROW_TTL)`; `adjustSlotCount(inventory, \"arrow\", -1)`; `consumeToolDurability(inventory, selectedSlot, BOW_DURABILITY_PER_SHOT)`; set `bowCooldownTimer = BOW_COOLDOWN`; `emit({type:\"bowFired\"})`.\n\n**`GameEngine.ts` `attack` case:** keep `emit attackSwung` (swing anim for the bow too), then `if (isBow(selected)) { tryFireBow(...); break; }` so the bow **never** falls through to `tryAttackMob`. Add `bowCooldownTimer` to `GameTimers` (`state.ts` + `createTimers`).\n\nInstant-fire chosen over draw-charge: the engine only sees a discrete `attack` command (hold-left is mining), so charge would need new continuous-input plumbing that conflicts with hold-to-mine. Fixed damage + `BOW_COOLDOWN` keeps it deterministic and testable.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Ranged skeletons (`mobAI.ts` / `mobs.ts`)\n\nAdd `ranged?: boolean` to `MobTemplate` (`mobs.ts`), `true` for skeleton (and boss). Aim direction always faces the player.\n- **Firing:** when `activeHostile && dist < detectRange && verticalGap < SKELETON_FIRE_VGAP && lineOfSight && attackTimer <= 0` → aim from mob eye to player chest with simple lead (`player.velocity * dist/ARROW_SPEED * SKELETON_LEAD_FACTOR`), `spawnArrow(... fromPlayer:false, damage:SKELETON_ARROW_DAMAGE)`, reset `attackTimer`, `emit mobAttacked` (drives existing skeleton attack sound). 50	export type GameEngineOptions = {
```
51	  /** A parsed save to restore, or null for a fresh world. */
52	  save?: SaveData | null;
53	  /** Seed for a fresh world; ignored when a save is provided. */
54	  seed?: number;
55	  /** Randomness source for mob spawning/AI — injectable for deterministic tests. */
56	  rng?: () => number;

59	};

61	/**
62	 * The framework-agnostic game core. Owns all simulation state, advances it in
63	 * step(), and accepts player intents through dispatch(). No React, no DOM, no
64	 * rendering — the renderer reads state, the React shell subscribes to
65	 * snapshots via subscribe()/getSnapshot() (useSyncExternalStore compatible).
66	 */
67	export class GameEngine {
68	  readonly state: GameState;
69	  private readonly rng: () => number;
70	  private readonly surfaceYAt: SurfaceYAtFn;
71	  private readonly listeners = new Set<() => void>();
72	  private events: GameEvent[] = [];
73	  private snapshot: GameSnapshot;
74	
75	  constructor(options: GameEngineOptions = {}) {
76	    const save = options.save ?? null;
77	    this.rng = options.rng ?? Math.random;
78	
79	    const seed = save?.seed ?? options.seed ?? Math.floor(Math.random() * 2147483647);
80	    const size = options.worldSize ?? { x: WORLD_SIZE_X, y: WORLD_SIZE_Y, z: WORLD_SIZE_Z };
81	    const world = new VoxelWorld(size.x, size.y, size.z, seed);
82	    generateWorld(world);
83	    // Re-derive the dungeon chest/spawner positions from the seed (the world is
84	    // regenerated deterministically each load, so these match generation).
85	    const dungeonSites = collectDungeonSites(world);
86	
87	    const blockChanges = createBlockChangeTracker(world);
88	    if (save) blockChanges.applySavedChanges(save.changes);
89	
90	    this.surfaceYAt = createSurfaceYAt(world);
91	
92	    const firstSpawn = findSpawnOnLand(world, Math.floor(world.sizeX / 2), Math.floor(world.sizeZ / 2));
93	    this.state = {
94	      world,
95	      blockChanges,
96	      player: {
97	        position: new THREE.Vector3(firstSpawn.x, firstSpawn.y, firstSpawn.z),
98	        velocity: new THREE.Vector3(),
99	        yaw: 0,
100	        pitch: 0,
101	        onGround: false
102	      },
103	      inventory: createInitialInventory(),
104	      equippedArmor: createEmptyArmorEquipment(),
105	      selectedSlot: 0,
106	      hearts: MAX_HEARTS,
107	      hunger: MAX_HUNGER,
108	      isDead: false,
109	      respawnTimer: 0,
110	      inventoryOpen: false,
111	      craftingStation: null,
112	      containers: new Map(),
113	      openContainerIndex: null,
114	      dungeonChestIndices: new Set(dungeonSites.chestIndices),
115	      dungeonSpawnerIndices: new Set(dungeonSites.spawnerIndices),
116	      lootedDungeonChests: new Set(),
117	      paused: false,
118	      debugOpen: false,
119	      debugInfo: null,
120	      cameraMode: "first",
121	      capsActive: false,
122	      mobs: [],
123	      nextMobId: 1,
124	      dayClock: 0,
125	      daylight: daylightAt(0),
126	      daylightPercent: Math.round(daylightAt(0) * 100),
127	      weather: { kind: "clear", intensity: 0 },
128	      sleepTimer: 0,
129	      spawnPoint: null,
130	      mining: { targetKey: "", progress: 0 },
131	      timers: createTimers(),
132	      worldMeshDirty: true
133	    };
134	
135	    if (save) {
136	      this.state.inventory = restoreInventorySlots(save) ?? this.state.inventory;
137	      this.state.equippedArmor = restoreEquippedArmor(save) ?? this.state.equippedArmor;
138	      this.state.selectedSlot = restoreSelectedSlot(save) ?? this.state.selectedSlot;
139	      this.state.hearts = restoreHearts(save) ?? this.state.hearts;
140	      this.state.hunger = restoreHungerLevel(save) ?? this.state.hunger;
141	      this.state.spawnPoint = restoreSpawnPoint(save);
142	      this.state.lootedDungeonChests = new Set(readLootedChests(save));
143	      // Restore chest contents only for indices that still hold a Chest block.
144	      for (const { index, slots } of readContainers(save)) {
145	        if (index >= 0 && index < world.blocks.length && world.blocks[index] === BlockId.Chest) {
146	          this.state.containers.set(index, slots);
147	        }
148	      }
149	      const savedClock = restoreDayClock(save);
150	      if (savedClock !== null) {
151	        this.state.dayClock = savedClock;
152	        this.state.daylight = daylightAt(savedClock);
153	        this.state.daylightPercent = Math.round(this.state.daylight * 100);
154	      }
155	      if (save.player) this.state.player.position.set(save.player.x, save.player.y, save.player.z);
156	    }
157	
158	    // Safety check: if stuck after load, relocate to a plain.
159	    if (collidesAt(world, this.state.player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT) || this.state.player.position.y < 2) {
160	      this.forceUnstuck();
161	    }
162	
163	    spawnInitialMobs(this.state, this.rng, this.surfaceYAt);
164	    // Seed weather from the (possibly restored) dayClock + player position so a
165	    // loaded save's first frame/snapshot is consistent before the first step().
166	    tickWeather(this.state);
167	    this.snapshot = this.buildSnapshot();
168	  }

170	  /** Advances the simulation by dt seconds. The renderer draws the state afterwards. */
171	  step(dt: number, input: FrameInput): void {
172	    const state = this.state;
173	    if (state.paused) {
174	      // Full freeze: mobs, the day clock, mining, and stats all stop.
175	      this.refreshSnapshot();
176	      return;
177	    }
178	    state.capsActive = input.capsActive;
179	
180	    // Stuck detection / auto-unstuck.
181	    const inBadState = collidesAt(state.world, state.player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT) || state.player.position.y < 2;
182	    state.timers.stuckTimer = inBadState ? state.timers.stuckTimer + dt : 0;
183	    if (state.timers.stuckTimer > STUCK_RESET_SECONDS) {
184	      this.forceUnstuck();
185	      state.timers.stuckTimer = 0;
186	    }
187	
188	    // Death: only mobs and the respawn countdown tick while dead.
189	    if (state.isDead) {
190	      if (tickRespawnTimer(state, dt)) this.respawn();
191	      else tickMobs(state, dt, this.mobTickDeps);
192	      this.refreshSnapshot();
193	      return;
194	    }
195	
196	    // Sleeping: a full freeze during the fade, then a jump to the next morning.
197	    if (state.sleepTimer > 0) {
198	      state.sleepTimer = Math.max(0, state.sleepTimer - dt);
199	      if (state.sleepTimer === 0) this.wakeToMorning();
200	      this.refreshSnapshot();
201	      return;
202	    }
203	
204	    const move = tickPlayerMotion(state, input, dt, this.applyDamage);
205	    if (move.didJump) this.emit({ type: "jumped" });
206	    if (move.didLand) this.emit({ type: "landed", impact: move.landImpact });
207	    tickHungerDrain(state, move);
208	    tickHealthRegen(state, dt);
209	    tickMining(state, input, dt, this.emit, this.rng);
210	    tickDayNight(state, dt);
211	    tickWeather(state);
212	    tickRandomBlocks(state, dt, this.rng);
213	    tickHostileSpawnDirector(state, dt, this.rng, this.surfaceYAt);
214	    tickSpawnerDirector(state, dt, this.rng, this.emit);
215	    tickMobs(state, dt, this.mobTickDeps);
216	    tickBreeding(state, dt, this.rng, this.surfaceYAt, this.emit);
217	    this.tickDebugInfo(dt);
218	
219	    this.refreshSnapshot();
220	  }
221	
222	  /** Applies a discrete player intent. */
223	  dispatch(command: Command): void {
224	    const state = this.state;
225	    switch (command.type) {
226	      case "selectSlot": {
227	        if (command.index >= 0 && command.index < Math.min(HOTBAR_SLOTS, state.inventory.length)) {
228	          state.selectedSlot = command.index;
229	        }
230	        break;
231	      }
232	      case "toggleInventory": {
233	        state.inventoryOpen = !state.inventoryOpen;
234	        if (!state.inventoryOpen) {
235	          state.craftingStation = null; // leaving the panel closes the station
236	          state.openContainerIndex = null; // ...and the open chest
237	        }
238	        break;
239	      }
240	      case "craft": {
241	        const recipe = RECIPES.find((entry) => entry.id === command.recipeId);
242	        if (!recipe || state.isDead) break;
243	        // Station recipes (e.g. furnace smelting) require that station to be open.
244	        // The UI gates these too, but dispatch is the spoofable surface to guard.
245	        if (recipe.station && recipe.station !== state.craftingStation) break;
246	        const next = inv.craft(state.inventory, recipe);
247	        if (!next) break;
248	        state.inventory = next;
249	        if (recipe.station) this.emit({ type: "smelted" });
250	        break;
251	      }
252	      case "swapSlots": {
253	        state.inventory = inv.swapSlots(state.inventory, command.from, command.to) ?? state.inventory;
254	        break;
255	      }
256	      case "moveStack": {
257	        this.applyMoveStack(command.from, command.to);
258	        break;
259	      }
260	      case "toggleEquipArmor": {
261	        state.equippedArmor = inv.toggleEquipArmor(state.inventory, state.equippedArmor, command.index) ?? state.equippedArmor;
262	        break;
263	      }
264	      case "eatFood": {
265	        if (state.isDead || state.inventoryOpen || state.sleepTimer > 0) break;
266	        const slot = state.inventory[state.selectedSlot];
267	        if (!slot?.id || slot.kind !== "food" || !slot.hunger || slot.count <= 0) break;
268	        const next = inv.adjustSlotCount(state.inventory, slot.id, -1, state.selectedSlot);
269	        if (!next) break;
270	        state.inventory = next;
271	        state.hunger = restoreHunger(state.hunger, slot.hunger);
272	        this.emit({ type: "ateFood" });
273	        break;
274	      }
275	      case "placeBlock": {
276	        if (state.isDead || state.inventoryOpen || state.sleepTimer > 0) break;
277	        // Right-click precedence: feed an aimed animal, then interact with the
278	        // aimed block (bed, furnace), then use the held item (hoe, seeds); only
279	        // place a block if none of those consumed the click.
280	        if (tryFeedAimedMob(state, this.emit)) break;
281	        if (tryInteractBlock(state, this.emit)) break;
282	        if (tryUseHeldItem(state, this.emit, this.rng)) break;
283	        placeSelectedBlock(state, this.emit);
284	        break;
285	      }
286	      case "attack": {
287	        if (state.isDead || state.inventoryOpen || state.sleepTimer > 0) break;
288	        this.emit({ type: "attackSwung" });
289	        const hitKind = tryAttackMob(state, weaponDamage(state), this.removeMobAt);
290	        if (hitKind) {
291	          this.emit({ type: "mobHit", kind: hitKind });
292	          state.inventory = inv.consumeToolDurability(state.inventory, state.selectedSlot, 1) ?? state.inventory;
293	          resetMining(state);
294	        }
295	        break;
296	      }
297	      case "unstuck": {
298	        if (state.isDead) break;
299	        this.forceUnstuck();
300	        break;
301	      }
302	      case "pause": {
303	        // The inventory panel and the death screen own their lock-loss; only
304	        // plain gameplay lock-loss (or an explicit Escape) opens the pause menu.
305	        // Sleeping is a brief, atomic freeze — pausing mid-fade would stall the
306	        // sleep timer (step early-returns on paused before the sleep branch).
307	        if (state.inventoryOpen || state.isDead || state.sleepTimer > 0) break;
308	        state.paused = true;
309	        state.craftingStation = null;
310	        state.openContainerIndex = null;
311	        break;
312	      }
313	      case "resume": {
314	        state.paused = false;
315	        break;
316	      }
317	      case "toggleDebug": {

320	        break;
321	      }
322	      case "toggleCameraView": {

324	        state.cameraMode = nextCameraMode(state.cameraMode);

326	      }
327	      case "respawn": {
328	        // Skip the rest of the countdown; the next step performs the respawn.
329	        if (state.isDead) state.respawnTimer = 0;

387	  /**
388	   * Moves a slot between the player inventory and the open chest. Indices at or
389	   * above CONTAINER_SLOT_BASE address the container; below it, the inventory.
390	   * Writes back whichever of the two arrays the move touched.
391	   */
392	  private applyMoveStack(from: number, to: number): void {
393	    const state = this.state;
394	    const container = state.openContainerIndex !== null ? state.containers.get(state.openContainerIndex) : undefined;
395	    const resolve = (index: number): { arr: InventorySlot[]; local: number } | null => {
396	      if (index >= CONTAINER_SLOT_BASE) return container ? { arr: container, local: index - CONTAINER_SLOT_BASE } : null;
397	      return { arr: state.inventory, local: index };
398	    };
399	    const a = resolve(from);
400	    const b = resolve(to);
401	    if (!a || !b) return;
402	    const moved = inv.moveStack(a.arr, a.local, b.arr, b.local);
403	    if (!moved) return;
404	
405	    // Resolve each side's destination BEFORE writing: the first write reassigns
406	    // state.inventory, which would make a later `arr === state.inventory` check
407	    // stale and misroute an inventory↔inventory move into the open chest.
408	    const aIsInventory = a.arr === state.inventory;
409	    const bIsInventory = b.arr === state.inventory;
410	    const writeBack = (isInventory: boolean, next: InventorySlot[]): void => {
411	      if (isInventory) state.inventory = next;
412	      else if (state.openContainerIndex !== null) state.containers.set(state.openContainerIndex, next);
413	    };
414	    writeBack(aIsInventory, moved.a);
415	    writeBack(bIsInventory, moved.b);
416	  }

435	    const drops = mob.ageTimer <= 0 ? rollMobDrops(mob.kind, this.rng) : [];

441	    if (drops.length > 0) this.emit({ type: "pickedUp", items: drops });
```

```
16	  surfaceYAt: SurfaceYAtFn;

23	export function tickMobs(state: GameState, dt: number, deps: MobTickDeps): void {
24	  const { world, daylight, mobs, isDead } = state;
25	  const playerPosition = state.player.position;
26	  const playerVelocity = state.player.velocity;
27	  const deadIndices: number[] = [];
28	
29	  for (let i = 0; i < mobs.length; i += 1) {
30	    const mob = mobs[i];
31	    mob.attackTimer -= dt;
32	    mob.turnTimer -= dt;
33	    const activeHostile = mob.hostile && (mob.kind !== "spider" || daylight < SPIDER_AGGRO_BELOW_DAYLIGHT);
34	
35	    scratchToPlayer.copy(playerPosition).sub(mob.position).setY(0);
36	    const distanceToPlayer = scratchToPlayer.length();
37	    scratchToPlayer3D.copy(playerPosition).sub(mob.position);
38	    const attackDistance = scratchToPlayer3D.length();
39	    const verticalGap = Math.abs(scratchToPlayer3D.y);
40	    let moveSpeed = mob.speed;
41	
42	    if (activeHostile && distanceToPlayer < mob.detectRange) {
43	      if (distanceToPlayer > 0.001) mob.direction.lerp(scratchToPlayer.normalize(), 0.2).normalize();
44	      moveSpeed *= 1.15;
45	    } else if (!mob.hostile && distanceToPlayer < 4.2) {
46	      if (distanceToPlayer > 0.001) mob.direction.lerp(scratchToPlayer.normalize().multiplyScalar(-1), 0.2).normalize();
47	      moveSpeed *= 1.15;
48	    } else if (mob.turnTimer <= 0) {
49	      mob.direction.applyAxisAngle(UP, (deps.rng() - 0.5) * Math.PI).normalize();
50	      mob.turnTimer = 1.5 + deps.rng() * 4;
51	    }
52	    mob.moveSpeed = moveSpeed;
53	
54	    let nx = mob.position.x + mob.direction.x * moveSpeed * dt;
55	    let nz = mob.position.z + mob.direction.z * moveSpeed * dt;
56	
57	    if (nx < 2 || nz < 2 || nx > world.sizeX - 2 || nz > world.sizeZ - 2) {
58	      mob.direction.multiplyScalar(-1);
59	      nx = mob.position.x + mob.direction.x * moveSpeed * dt;
60	      nz = mob.position.z + mob.direction.z * moveSpeed * dt;
61	      mob.turnTimer = 1;
62	    }
63	
64	    const ground = deps.surfaceYAt(nx, nz);
65	    mob.position.set(nx, ground + mob.halfHeight, nz);
66	    mob.yaw = Math.atan2(mob.direction.x, mob.direction.z);
67	
68	    let hasLineOfSight = true;
69	    if (activeHostile && attackDistance < 4 && verticalGap < 1.6) {
70	      scratchMobEye.set(mob.position.x, mob.position.y + mob.halfHeight * 0.35, mob.position.z);
71	      scratchPlayerAim.set(playerPosition.x, playerPosition.y + 0.9, playerPosition.z);
72	      scratchRay.copy(scratchPlayerAim).sub(scratchMobEye);
73	      if (scratchRay.lengthSq() > 1e-6) {
74	        const hit = voxelRaycast(world, scratchMobEye, scratchRay.normalize(), attackDistance + 0.5);
75	        hasLineOfSight = hit === null;
76	      }
77	    }
78	
79	    // !isDead: mobs keep ticking through the respawn countdown, but biting a
80	    // corpse should neither sound nor re-arm the attack cooldown.
81	    if (!isDead && activeHostile && attackDistance < 4 && verticalGap < 1.6 && hasLineOfSight && mob.attackTimer <= 0) {
82	      deps.emit({ type: "mobAttacked", kind: mob.kind });
83	      deps.applyDamage(mob.attackDamage);
84	      if (distanceToPlayer > 0.001) {
85	        scratchToPlayer.normalize().multiplyScalar(4.2);
86	        playerVelocity.x += scratchToPlayer.x;
87	        playerVelocity.z += scratchToPlayer.z;
88	        playerVelocity.y = Math.max(playerVelocity.y, 3.4);
89	      }
90	      mob.attackTimer = mob.attackCooldown;
91	    }
92	
93	    // Zombies and skeletons burn in broad daylight.
94	    if (mob.hostile && mob.kind !== "spider" && daylight > HOSTILE_BURN_ABOVE_DAYLIGHT) {
95	      mob.hp -= dt * 0.8;
96	    }
97	
98	    if (mob.hp <= 0) deadIndices.push(i);
99	  }
100	
101	  for (let i = deadIndices.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) deps.removeMobAt(deadIndices[i]);
102	}
```

```
63	  };

65	  const forwardInput = (keys.has("KeyW") ? 1 : 0) - (keys.has("KeyS") ? 1 : 0);
66	  const strafeInput = (keys.has("KeyD") ? 1 : 0) - (keys.has("KeyA") ? 1 : 0);
67	  const wantsJump = keys.has("Space");
68	  const crouching = keys.has("KeyC");
69	
70	  forwardFromYaw(player.yaw, scratchForward);
71	  scratchRight.crossVectors(scratchForward, UP).normalize();
72	  scratchMoveDir.set(0, 0, 0);
73	  scratchMoveDir.addScaledVector(scratchForward, forwardInput);
74	  scratchMoveDir.addScaledVector(scratchRight, strafeInput);
75	  if (scratchMoveDir.lengthSq() > 0) scratchMoveDir.normalize();
76	
77	  const speedScale = speedScaleFromHunger(state.hunger);
78	  const canSprint = state.hunger > SPRINT_MIN_HUNGER;
79	  const sprinting = canSprint && forwardInput > 0 && keys.has("KeyW") && input.capsActive && !crouching;
80	  const speed = crouching ? CROUCH_SPEED : sprinting ? SPRINT_SPEED * speedScale : WALK_SPEED * speedScale;
81	
82	  player.velocity.x = scratchMoveDir.x * speed;
83	  player.velocity.z = scratchMoveDir.z * speed;
84	
85	  const wasGrounded = player.onGround;
86	  player.velocity.y -= GRAVITY * dt;
87	  let didJump = false;
88	  if (wantsJump && player.onGround && !crouching) {
89	    player.velocity.y = JUMP_VELOCITY;
90	    player.onGround = false;
91	    didJump = true;
92	  }
93	
94	  const vyBeforeMove = player.velocity.y;
95	  const startX = player.position.x;
96	  const startZ = player.position.z;
97	  const prevX = player.position.x;
98	  const prevZ = player.position.z;
99	
100	  player.onGround = false;
101	  stepAxis("x", player.velocity.x * dt);
102	  stepAxis("z", player.velocity.z * dt);
103	  stepAxis("y", player.velocity.y * dt);
104	
105	  // Depenetration: if still colliding after movement, nudge up
106	  if (collidesAt(world, player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT)) {
107	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {
108	      player.position.y += 0.2;
109	      if (!collidesAt(world, player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT)) break;
110	    }
111	  }
112	
113	  if (crouching && (player.onGround || wasGrounded) && !hasSupportUnderPlayer(world, player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH + 0.12)) {
114	    player.position.x = prevX;
115	    player.position.z = prevZ;
116	    player.velocity.x = 0;
117	    player.velocity.z = 0;
118	  }
119	
120	  player.position.x = Math.min(world.sizeX - WORLD_BORDER_PADDING, Math.max(WORLD_BORDER_PADDING, player.position.x));
121	  player.position.z = Math.min(world.sizeZ - WORLD_BORDER_PADDING, Math.max(WORLD_BORDER_PADDING, player.position.z));
122	
123	  if (!wasGrounded && player.onGround && vyBeforeMove < -14) {
124	    // Any fall hard enough to trigger this deals at least half a heart.
125	    applyDamage(Math.max(1, Math.min(19, Math.floor((-vyBeforeMove - 13) * 0.5))));
126	  }
127	
128	  const inVoid = player.position.y < -4;
129	  if (inVoid) {
130	    timers.voidTimer += dt;
131	    if (timers.voidTimer >= 0.4) {
132	      applyDamage(1);
133	      timers.voidTimer = 0;
134	    }
135	  } else {
136	    timers.voidTimer = 0;
137	  }
138	
139	  const horizontalDistance = Math.hypot(player.position.x - startX, player.position.z - startZ);
140	  const moving = horizontalDistance > 1e-4;
141	  const didSprint = sprinting && moving;
142	  const didWalk = !didSprint && moving;
143	  const didLand = !wasGrounded && player.onGround && vyBeforeMove < 0;
144	  return { didSprint, didWalk, didJump, didLand, landImpact: didLand ? -vyBeforeMove : 0, horizontalDistance };
145	}
146
```

```
4	export type SurfaceYAtFn = (x: number, z: number) => number;
5	
6	export function createSurfaceYAt(world: VoxelWorld): SurfaceYAtFn {
7	  return (x: number, z: number) => {
8	    const ix = Math.floor(x);
9	    const iz = Math.floor(z);
10	    if (ix < 0 || iz < 0 || ix >= world.sizeX || iz >= world.sizeZ) return 1;
11	    return world.highestSolidY(ix, iz) + 1;
12	  };
13	}
14	
15	/**
16	 * Deterministic spiral search for a safe spawn column: solid dry floor, two
17	 * air blocks for the body, gently sloped neighbors, preferring Plains. Falls
18	 * back to any biome, then to the search center.
19	 */
20	export function findSpawnOnLand(world: VoxelWorld, centerX: number, centerZ: number, seekPlains = true): { x: number; y: number; z: number } {
21	  const isGoodSpawn = (x: number, y: number, z: number): boolean => {
22	    const top = world.get(x, y - 1, z);
23	    const atBody = world.get(x, y, z);
24	    const atHead = world.get(x, y + 1, z);
25	    if (!world.isSolid(x, y - 1, z)) return false;
26	    if (atBody === BlockId.Water || atHead === BlockId.Water || top === BlockId.Water) return false;
27	    if (atBody !== BlockId.Air || atHead !== BlockId.Air) return false;
28	    if (seekPlains && world.getBiome(x, z) !== BiomeId.Plains) return false;
29	
30	    const h0 = world.highestSolidY(x + 1, z);
31	    const h1 = world.highestSolidY(x - 1, z);
32	    const h2 = world.highestSolidY(x, z + 1);
33	    const h3 = world.highestSolidY(x, z - 1);
34	    const ny = y - 1;
35	    return Math.abs(h0 - ny) <= 2 && Math.abs(h1 - ny) <= 2 && Math.abs(h2 - ny) <= 2 && Math.abs(h3 - ny) <= 2;
36	  };
37	
38	  const maxRadius = Math.min(300, Math.floor(Math.min(world.sizeX, world.sizeZ) * 0.4));
39	  for (let radius = 0; radius <= maxRadius; radius += 2) {
40	    for (let i = 0; i < 32; i += 1) {
41	      const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 32;
42	      const x = Math.max(5, Math.min(world.sizeX - 6, Math.floor(centerX + Math.cos(angle) * radius)));
43	      const z = Math.max(5, Math.min(world.sizeZ - 6, Math.floor(centerZ + Math.sin(angle) * radius)));
44	      const topY = world.highestSolidY(x, z);
45	      const y = topY + 1;
46	      if (isGoodSpawn(x, y, z)) return { x, y, z };
47	    }
48	  }
49	
50	  if (seekPlains) return findSpawnOnLand(world, centerX, centerZ, false);
51	
52	  const topY = world.highestSolidY(centerX, centerZ);
53	  return { x: centerX, y: topY + 1, z: centerZ };
54	}
55	
56	/** True when the surface position is dry: not a flooded column (seabed/lake floor). */
57	function isDrySurface(world: VoxelWorld, x: number, y: number, z: number): boolean {
58	  return world.get(Math.floor(x), y, Math.floor(z)) !== BlockId.Water;
59	}
60	
61	export function randomLandPoint(world: VoxelWorld, surfaceYAt: SurfaceYAtFn, rng: () => number = Math.random): THREE.Vector3 {
62	  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i += 1) {
63	    const x = 10 + rng() * (world.sizeX - 20);
64	    const z = 10 + rng() * (world.sizeZ - 20);
65	    const y = surfaceYAt(x, z);
66	    if (y > 2 && isDrySurface(world, x, y, z)) return new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
67	  }
68	  return new THREE.Vector3(world.sizeX / 2, 12, world.sizeZ / 2);
69	}
70	
71	export function randomLandPointNear(
72	  world: VoxelWorld,
73	  surfaceYAt: SurfaceYAtFn,
74	  centerX: number,
75	  centerZ: number,
76	  radius: number,
77	  rng: () => number = Math.random
78	): THREE.Vector3 {
79	  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i += 1) {
80	    const x = centerX + (rng() * 2 - 1) * radius;
81	    const z = centerZ + (rng() * 2 - 1) * radius;
82	    const clampedX = Math.max(10, Math.min(world.sizeX - 10, x));
83	    const clampedZ = Math.max(10, Math.min(world.sizeZ - 10, z));
84	    const y = surfaceYAt(clampedX, clampedZ);
85	    if (y > 2 && isDrySurface(world, clampedX, y, clampedZ)) return new THREE.Vector3(clampedX, y, clampedZ);
86	  }
87	  return randomLandPoint(world, surfaceYAt, rng);
88	}
```

```
2	import { VoxelWorld } from "./voxelWorld";
3	
4	export type RaycastResult = {
5	  hit: THREE.Vector3;
6	  previous: THREE.Vector3;
7	  /** Ray parameter where the ray enters the hit cell (0 when the origin cell is already solid). */
8	  distance: number;
9	};
10	
11	// DDA voxel traversal. `previous` is the last empty cell before the hit —
12	// face-adjacent to it, never diagonal — which is where placed blocks go.
13	export function voxelRaycast(world: VoxelWorld, origin: THREE.Vector3, direction: THREE.Vector3, maxDist = 6): RaycastResult | null {
14	  const dir = direction.clone().normalize();
15	  const pos = origin.clone();
16	
17	  let x = Math.floor(pos.x);
18	  let y = Math.floor(pos.y);
19	  let z = Math.floor(pos.z);
20	
21	  const stepX = dir.x > 0 ? 1 : -1;
22	  const stepY = dir.y > 0 ? 1 : -1;
23	  const stepZ = dir.z > 0 ? 1 : -1;
24	
25	  const invDx = Math.abs(1 / (dir.x || 1e-6));
26	  const invDy = Math.abs(1 / (dir.y || 1e-6));
27	  const invDz = Math.abs(1 / (dir.z || 1e-6));
28	
29	  let tMaxX = ((stepX > 0 ? x + 1 : x) - pos.x) / (dir.x || 1e-6);
30	  let tMaxY = ((stepY > 0 ? y + 1 : y) - pos.y) / (dir.y || 1e-6);
31	  let tMaxZ = ((stepZ > 0 ? z + 1 : z) - pos.z) / (dir.z || 1e-6);
32	  if (tMaxX < 0) tMaxX += invDx;
33	  if (tMaxY < 0) tMaxY += invDy;
34	  if (tMaxZ < 0) tMaxZ += invDz;
35	
36	  let t = 0;
37	  let previous = new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
38	
39	  while (t <= maxDist) {
40	    if (world.isSolid(x, y, z)) return { hit: new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z), previous, distance: t };
41	    previous = new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
42	
43	    if (tMaxX < tMaxY) {
44	      if (tMaxX < tMaxZ) {
45	        x += stepX;
46	        t = tMaxX;
47	        tMaxX += invDx;
48	      } else {
49	        z += stepZ;
50	        t = tMaxZ;
51	        tMaxZ += invDz;
52	      }
53	    } else if (tMaxY < tMaxZ) {
54	      y += stepY;
55	      t = tMaxY;
56	      tMaxY += invDy;
57	    } else {
58	      z += stepZ;
59	      t = tMaxZ;
60	      tMaxZ += invDz;
61	    }
62	  }
63	
64	  return null;
65	}
66	
67	// AABB-vs-voxel test. `position` is the feet center; the box extends halfWidth
68	// on x/z and height on y. Water never collides.
69	export function collidesAt(world: VoxelWorld, position: THREE.Vector3, halfWidth: number, height: number): boolean {
70	  const eps = 0.001;
71	  const minX = Math.floor(position.x - halfWidth + eps);
72	  const maxX = Math.floor(position.x + halfWidth - eps);
73	  const minZ = Math.floor(position.z - halfWidth + eps);
74	  const maxZ = Math.floor(position.z + halfWidth - eps);
75	  const minY = Math.floor(position.y + eps);
76	  const maxY = Math.floor(position.y + height - eps);
77	
78	  for (let y = minY; y <= maxY; y += 1) {
79	    for (let z = minZ; z <= maxZ; z += 1) {
80	      for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x += 1) {
81	        if (world.isSolid(x, y, z)) return true;
82	      }
83	    }
84	  }
85	
86	  return false;
87	}
88	
89	export function hasSupportUnderPlayer(world: VoxelWorld, position: THREE.Vector3, halfWidth: number): boolean {
90	  const minX = Math.floor(position.x - halfWidth);
91	  const maxX = Math.floor(position.x + halfWidth);
92	  const minZ = Math.floor(position.z - halfWidth);
93	  const maxZ = Math.floor(position.z + halfWidth);
94	  const y = Math.floor(position.y - 0.05);
95	
96	  for (let z = minZ; z <= maxZ; z += 1) {
97	    for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x += 1) {
98	      if (world.isSolid(x, y, z)) return true;
99	    }
100	  }
101	
102	  return false;
103	}
```

```
1	import { BiomeId, BlockId, WORLD_SIZE_X, WORLD_SIZE_Y, WORLD_SIZE_Z } from "./blocks";
2	
3	/**
4	 * Voxel data store plus cheap world queries. Terrain generation lives in
5	 * generation.ts, meshing in meshing.ts, raycast/collision in queries.ts.
6	 *
7	 * ⚠ Save-format invariants: saves address voxels through index(), and getBiome()
8	 * feeds terrain generation. Changing either breaks every existing save — see
9	 * generation.test.ts.
10	 */
11	export class VoxelWorld {
12	  readonly sizeX: number;
13	  readonly sizeY: number;
14	  readonly sizeZ: number;
15	  readonly seed: number;
16	  readonly blocks: Uint8Array;
17	
18	  constructor(sizeX = WORLD_SIZE_X, sizeY = WORLD_SIZE_Y, sizeZ = WORLD_SIZE_Z, seed = 1337) {
19	    this.sizeX = sizeX;
20	    this.sizeY = sizeY;
21	    this.sizeZ = sizeZ;
22	    this.seed = seed;
23	    this.blocks = new Uint8Array(sizeX * sizeY * sizeZ);
24	  }
25	
26	  index(x: number, y: number, z: number): number {
27	    return x + z * this.sizeX + y * this.sizeX * this.sizeZ;
28	  }
29	
30	  inBounds(x: number, y: number, z: number): boolean {
31	    return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && z >= 0 && x < this.sizeX && y < this.sizeY && z < this.sizeZ;
32	  }
33	
34	  get(x: number, y: number, z: number): number {
35	    if (!this.inBounds(x, y, z)) return BlockId.Air;
36	    return this.blocks[this.index(x, y, z)];
37	  }
38	
39	  set(x: number, y: number, z: number, block: BlockId): void {
40	    if (!this.inBounds(x, y, z)) return;
41	    this.blocks[this.index(x, y, z)] = block;
42	  }
43	
44	  isSolid(x: number, y: number, z: number): boolean {
45	    const block = this.get(x, y, z);
46	    return block !== BlockId.Air && block !== BlockId.Water;
47	  }
48	
49	  highestSolidY(x: number, z: number): number {
50	    for (let y = this.sizeY - 1; y >= 0; y -= 1) {
51	      if (this.isSolid(x, y, z)) return y;
52	    }
53	    return 0;
54	  }
55	
56	  getBiome(x: number, z: number): BiomeId {
57	    // Two incommensurate, direction-rotated sine octaves per field, with
58	    // dominant wavelengths of ~250-900 blocks: each field traverses several
59	    // cycles across the 512-block map, so every world gets coherent patches
60	    // of all five biomes (~60-150 block scale).
61	    const s = this.seed * 0.007;
62	    const temp = Math.sin(x * 0.013 + z * 0.006 + s * 1.3) * 0.6 + Math.sin(x * 0.029 - z * 0.017 + s * 2.4) * 0.4;
63	    const moisture = Math.sin(x * 0.007 - z * 0.012 + s * 0.8) * 0.6 + Math.sin(x * 0.019 + z * 0.023 - s * 1.6) * 0.4;
64	    const continental = Math.sin(x * 0.008 + z * 0.01 + s * 2.1) * 0.55 + Math.sin(x * 0.014 - z * 0.009 - s * 1.7) * 0.45;
65	    const ridge = Math.sin(x * 0.024 + z * 0.02 + s) * 0.5 + Math.sin(x * 0.016 - z * 0.024 - s) * 0.5;
66	
67	    if (continental < -0.52) return BiomeId.Ocean;
68	    if ((continental > 0.5 && ridge > 0) || ridge > 0.8) return BiomeId.Mountains;
69	    if (temp > 0.2 && moisture < -0.12) return BiomeId.Desert;
70	    if (moisture > 0.18) return BiomeId.Forest;
71	    return BiomeId.Plains;
72	  }
73	}
74
```

```
import * as THREE from "three";
import { BlockId } from "@/lib/world";
import {
  HOSTILE_CAP,
  HOSTILE_SPAWN_BELOW_DAYLIGHT,
  HOSTILE_SPAWN_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
  RENDER_RADIUS,
  SPAWNER_ACTIVATION_RADIUS,
  SPAWNER_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
  SPAWNER_LOCAL_CAP
} from "@/lib/game/config";
import { MOB_TEMPLATES, mobHalfHeight } from "@/lib/game/mobs";
import { randomLandPointNear, type SurfaceYAtFn } from "@/lib/game/spawn";
import type { MobKind } from "@/lib/game/types";
import type { EmitGameEvent, GameState, MobState } from "../state";

export type SpawnGroupArgs = {
  kind: MobKind;
  hostile: boolean;
  count: number;
  centerX: number;
  centerZ: number;
  radius: number;
};

/** Adds one mob standing with its feet at (x, y, z) (y is the ground, not the body center). */
function pushMob(state: GameState, kind: MobKind, hostile: boolean, x: number, y: number, z: number, rng: () => number): void {
  const template = MOB_TEMPLATES[kind];
  const halfHeight = mobHalfHeight(kind);
  const mob: MobState = {
    id: state.nextMobId,
    kind,
    hostile,
    hp: template.hp,
    position: new THREE.Vector3(x, y + halfHeight, z),
    direction: new THREE.Vector3(rng() - 0.5, 0, rng() - 0.5).normalize(),
    yaw: 0,
    turnTimer: 1 + rng() * 3,
    speed: template.speed,
    moveSpeed: template.speed,
    detectRange: template.detectRange,
    attackDamage: template.attackDamage,
    attackCooldown: template.attackCooldown,
    attackTimer: rng(),
    halfHeight,
    bobSeed: rng() * 10,
    fedTimer: 0,
    ageTimer: 0
  };
  state.nextMobId += 1;
  state.mobs.push(mob);
}

export function spawnMobGroup(state: GameState, args: SpawnGroupArgs, rng: () => number, surfaceYAt: SurfaceYAtFn): void {
  for (let i = 0; i < args.count; i += 1) {
    const spawnPos = randomLandPointNear(state.world, surfaceYAt, args.centerX, args.centerZ, args.radius, rng);
    pushMob(state, args.kind, args.hostile, spawnPos.x, spawnPos.y, spawnPos.z, rng);
  }
}

/**
 * The day-one population around the player's spawn point. Passives scatter
 * over a wider ring than hostiles so the spawn area doesn't feel like a
 * petting zoo; hostiles stay closer (the dawn-aggro behavior tests document).
 */
export function spawnInitialMobs(state: GameState, rng: () => number, surfaceYAt: SurfaceYAtFn): void {
  const centerX = state.player.position.x;
  const centerZ = state.player.position.z;
  const passiveRadius = RENDER_RADIUS * 1.2;
  const hostileRadius = RENDER_RADIUS * 0.7;
  const groups: Array<[MobKind, boolean, number, number]> = [
    ["sheep", false, 6, passiveRadius],
    ["chicken", false, 5, passiveRadius],
    ["horse", false, 3, passiveRadius],
    ["zombie", true, 8, hostileRadius],
    ["skeleton", true, 6, hostileRadius],
    ["spider", true, 6, hostileRadius]
  ];
  for (const [kind, hostile, count, radius] of groups) {
    spawnMobGroup(state, { kind, hostile, count, centerX, centerZ, radius }, rng, surfaceYAt);
```

```
96	    state,
97	    {
98	      kind,
99	      hostile: true,
100	      count: 1 + (rng() > 0.7 ? 1 : 0),
101	      centerX: state.player.position.x,
102	      centerZ: state.player.position.z,
103	      radius: Math.max(26, RENDER_RADIUS * 0.85)
104	    },
105	    rng,
106	    surfaceYAt
107	  );
108	}

110	const SPAWNER_KINDS: ReadonlyArray<"zombie" | "skeleton" | "spider"> = ["zombie", "skeleton", "spider"];
111	
112	/**
113	 * Drips hostiles from dungeon spawners. On each interval, every intact spawner
114	 * with the player inside its activation radius spawns one hostile on the room
115	 * floor (feet at the spawner's own y, not the surface), bounded by a local
116	 * cluster cap and the shared global HOSTILE_CAP. Time-independent — dungeons
117	 * are dark. Spawner positions come from the session-derived index set, so
118	 * mining out a spawner block stops it (the world.get check below).
119	 */
120	export function tickSpawnerDirector(state: GameState, dt: number, rng: () => number, emit: EmitGameEvent): void {
121	  if (state.dungeonSpawnerIndices.size === 0) return;
122	  state.timers.spawnerTimer += dt;
123	  if (state.timers.spawnerTimer < SPAWNER_INTERVAL_SECONDS) return;
124	  state.timers.spawnerTimer = 0;
125	
126	  const countHostiles = () => state.mobs.reduce((acc, mob) => acc + (mob.hostile ? 1 : 0), 0);
127	  if (countHostiles() >= HOSTILE_CAP) return;
128	
129	  const { player, world } = state;
130	  const layer = world.sizeX * world.sizeZ;
131	  for (const idx of state.dungeonSpawnerIndices) {
132	    const sy = Math.floor(idx / layer);
133	    const rem = idx - sy * layer;
134	    const sz = Math.floor(rem / world.sizeX);
135	    const sx = rem - sz * world.sizeX;
136	    if (world.get(sx, sy, sz) !== BlockId.Spawner) continue; // mined out → inert
137	    if (Math.hypot(player.position.x - (sx + 0.5), player.position.y - (sy + 0.5), player.position.z - (sz + 0.5)) > SPAWNER_ACTIVATION_RADIUS) continue;
138	    if (countHostiles() >= HOSTILE_CAP) break;
139	
140	    const nearby = state.mobs.reduce(
141	      (acc, mob) => acc + (mob.hostile && Math.hypot(mob.position.x - (sx + 0.5), mob.position.z - (sz + 0.5)) <= SPAWNER_ACTIVATION_RADIUS ? 1 : 0),
142	      0
143	    );
144	    if (nearby >= SPAWNER_LOCAL_CAP) continue;
145	
146	    const kind = SPAWNER_KINDS[Math.floor(rng() * SPAWNER_KINDS.length)];
147	    const jx = sx + 0.5 + (rng() * 2 - 1) * 1.2;
148	    const jz = sz + 0.5 + (rng() * 2 - 1) * 1.2;
149	    pushMob(state, kind, true, jx, sy, jz, rng);
150	    emit({ type: "mobSpawned", kind, x: sx + 0.5, y: sy + 0.5, z: sz + 0.5 });
151	  }
152	}
153
```

```
1	import { MAX_HEARTS, MAX_HUNGER, RESPAWN_SECONDS } from "@/lib/game/config";

3	import type { GameState } from "../state";
4	
5	/**
6	 * Applies armor-mitigated damage (always at least 1) and wears equipped armor.
7	 * Returns true when the hit was lethal — the engine emits the death event.
8	 */
9	export function applyDamageWithArmor(state: GameState, amount: number): boolean {
10	  if (state.isDead) return false;
11	  const value = Math.max(0, Math.floor(amount));
12	  if (value <= 0) return false;
13	
14	  state.inventory = consumeEquippedArmorDurability(state.inventory, state.equippedArmor, 1) ?? state.inventory;
15	  const reduction = armorReduction(state.inventory, state.equippedArmor);
16	  const mitigated = Math.max(1, Math.floor(value * (1 - reduction)));
17	
18	  state.hearts = Math.max(0, state.hearts - mitigated);
19	  if (state.hearts > 0) return false;
20	
21	  state.isDead = true;
22	  state.respawnTimer = RESPAWN_SECONDS;
23	  return true;
24	}
25	
26	/**
27	 * Counts down the respawn timer while dead. Returns true when the player
28	 * comes back to life this tick — the engine then performs the respawn.
29	 */
30	export function tickRespawnTimer(state: GameState, dt: number): boolean {
31	  if (!state.isDead) return false;
32	  state.respawnTimer -= dt;
33	  if (state.respawnTimer > 0) return false;
34	
35	  state.hearts = MAX_HEARTS;
36	  state.hunger = MAX_HUNGER;
37	  state.isDead = false;
38	  state.respawnTimer = 0;
39	  return true;
40	}
```

```json
{
```

```json
  "content": "import * as THREE from \"three\";\nimport type { GameState, ProjectileState } from \"./state\";\n\nexport type SpawnArrowOptions = {\n  speed: number;\n  damage: number;\n  knockback: number;\n  fromPlayer: boolean;\n  ttl: number;\n};\n\n// Spawn the arrow a little ahead of the muzzle so the firer never collides with\n// its own arrow on the spawn frame.\nconst MUZZLE_OFFSET = 0.6;\n\nconst scratchDir = new THREE.Vector3();\n\n/**\n * Launches an arrow from (originX, originY, originZ) along `dir`. The single\n * launch path shared by the player's bow, ranged skeletons, and the boss.\n * Returns the created projectile (handy for tests).\n */\nexport function spawnArrow(\n  state: GameState,\n  originX: number,\n  originY: number,\n  originZ: number,\n  dir: THREE.Vector3,\n  opts: SpawnArrowOptions\n): ProjectileState {\n  scratchDir.copy(dir);\n  if (scratchDir.lengthSq() < 1e-9) scratchDir.set(0, 0, -1);\n  scratchDir.normalize();\n\n  const velocity = scratchDir.clone().multiplyScalar(opts.speed);\n  const projectile: ProjectileState = {\n    id: state.nextProjectileId,\n    position: new THREE.Vector3(\n      originX + scratchDir.x * MUZZLE_OFFSET,\n      originY + scratchDir.y * MUZZLE_OFFSET,\n      originZ + scratchDir.z * MUZZLE_OFFSET\n    ),\n    velocity,\n    yaw: Math.atan2(scratchDir.x, scratchDir.z),\n    pitch: Math.asin(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, scratchDir.y))),\n    damage: opts.damage,\n    knockback: opts.knockback,\n    fromPlayer: opts.fromPlayer,\n    ttl: opts.ttl\n  };\n\n  state.nextProjectileId += 1;\n  state.projectiles.push(projectile);\n  return projectile;\n}\n"
}
```

```json
  "content": "import * as THREE from \"three\";\nimport { voxelRaycast } from \"@/lib/world\";\nimport { ARROW_GRAVITY, ARROW_HIT_RADIUS, ARROW_MAX_SEGMENT, ARROW_MAX_SUBSTEPS, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT } from \"@/lib/game/config\";\nimport type { EmitGameEvent, GameState, MobState } from \"../state\";\n\nexport type ProjectileTickDeps = {\n  applyDamage: (amount: number) => void;\n  removeMobAt: (index: number) => void;\n  emit: EmitGameEvent;\n};\n\n// Scratch vectors — the tick runs every frame over every arrow and must not allocate.\nconst segDir = new THREE.Vector3();\nconst knock = new THREE.Vector3();\n\n/**\n * Distance along the unit-direction segment [origin, origin + dir*len] of the\n * point on it closest to (px, py, pz), clamped to the segment endpoints.\n */\nfunction closestParam(ox: number, oy: number, oz: number, dx: number, dy: number, dz: number, len: number, px: number, py: number, pz: number): number {\n  const t = (px - ox) * dx + (py - oy) * dy + (pz - oz) * dz;\n  return t < 0 ? 0 : t > len ? len : t;\n}\n\n// A boss body is far wider than the default padding suits, so widen the hit\n// cylinder for tall mobs; ordinary mobs keep the tight 0.45 padding.\nfunction mobBodyRadius(mob: MobState): number {\n  return ARROW_HIT_RADIUS + (mob.halfHeight > 1.4 ? 0.9 : 0);\n}\n\n/**\n * Advances every in-flight arrow. Each arrow integrates under gravity in capped\n * substeps so a fast shot can't skip a 1-block wall or a thin mob: per substep\n * it sweeps the world DDA for a block hit and tests the segment against the\n * relevant entity (mobs for player arrows, the player for mob arrows), resolving\n * whichever is nearer. Spent arrows (hit, expired, or out of bounds) despawn.\n */\nexport function tickProjectiles(state: GameState, dt: number, deps: ProjectileTickDeps): void {\n  const { world, projectiles } = state;\n  if (projectiles.length === 0) return;\n  const dead: number[] = [];\n\n  for (let i = 0; i < projectiles.length; i += 1) {\n    const p = projectiles[i];\n    p.ttl -= dt;\n    if (p.ttl <= 0) {\n      dead.push(i);\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    const substeps = Math.min(ARROW_MAX_SUBSTEPS, Math.max(1, Math.ceil((p.velocity.length() * dt) / ARROW_MAX_SEGMENT)));\n    const sdt = dt / substeps;\n    let removed = false;\n\n    for (let s = 0; s < substeps && !removed; s += 1) {\n      p.velocity.y -= ARROW_GRAVITY * sdt;\n      const segLen = p.velocity.length() * sdt;\n      if (segLen < 1e-9) continue;\n      segDir.copy(p.velocity).divideScalar(p.velocity.length());\n\n      // Swept block collision (reuses the world DDA used for mining/line-of-sight).\n      let blockT = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n      const blockHit = voxelRaycast(world, p.position, segDir, segLen);\n      if (blockHit && blockHit.distance <= segLen) blockT = blockHit.distance;\n\n      // Nearest entity along the segment.\n      let entityT = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n      let hitMobIndex = -1;\n      if (p.fromPlayer) {\n        for (let m = 0; m < state.mobs.length; m += 1) {\n          const mob = state.mobs[m];\n          const t = closestParam(p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z, segDir.x, segDir.y, segDir.z, segLen, mob.position.x, mob.position.y, mob.position.z);\n          const horiz = Math.hypot(p.position.x + segDir.x * t - mob.position.x, p.position.z + segDir.z * t - mob.position.z);\n          const vert = Math.abs(p.position.y + segDir.y * t - mob.position.y);\n          if (horiz <= mobBodyRadius(mob) && vert <= mob.halfHeight + ARROW_HIT_RADIUS && t < entityT) {\n            entityT = t;\n            hitMobIndex = m;\n          }\n        }\n      } else {\n        const feet = state.player.position;\n        const midY = feet.y + PLAYER_HEIGHT / 2;\n        const t = closestParam(p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z, segDir.x, segDir.y, segDir.z, segLen, feet.x, midY, feet.z);\n        const horiz = Math.hypot(p.position.x + segDir.x * t - feet.x, p.position.z + segDir.z * t - feet.z);\n        const vert = Math.abs(p.position.y + segDir.y * t - midY);\n        if (horiz <= PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH + ARROW_HIT_RADIUS && vert <= PLAYER_HEIGHT / 2 + ARROW_HIT_RADIUS) entityT = t;\n      }\n\n      if (entityT !== Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY && entityT <= blockT) {\n        const hx = p.position.x + segDir.x * entityT;\n        const hy = p.position.y + segDir.y * entityT;\n        const hz = p.position.z + segDir.z * entityT;\n        if (p.fromPlayer) {\n          const mob = state.mobs[hitMobIndex];\n          mob.hp -= p.damage;\n          knock.set(segDir.x, 0, segDir.z);\n          if (knock.lengthSq() > 1e-6) {\n            knock.normalize();\n            mob.direction.copy(knock);\n            mob.position.addScaledVector(knock, p.knockback);\n            mob.position.y += 0.1;\n          }\n          deps.emit({ type: \"mobHit\", kind: mob.kind });\n          deps.emit({ type: \"arrowHit\", x: hx, y: hy, z: hz, target: \"mob\" });\n          if (mob.hp <= 0) deps.removeMobAt(hitMobIndex);\n        } else {\n          deps.applyDamage(p.damage);\n          state.player.velocity.x += segDir.x * p.knockback;\n          state.player.velocity.z += segDir.z * p.knockback;\n          deps.emit({ type: \"arrowHit\", x: hx, y: hy, z: hz, target: \"player\" });\n        }\n        removed = true;\n      } else if (blockT !== Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY) {\n        deps.emit({ type: \"arrowHit\", x: p.position.x + segDir.x * blockT, y: p.position.y + segDir.y * blockT, z: p.position.z + segDir.z * blockT, target: \"block\" });\n        removed = true;\n      } else {\n        p.position.addScaledVector(segDir, segLen);\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!removed) {\n      const speed = p.velocity.length();\n      p.yaw = Math.atan2(p.velocity.x, p.velocity.z);\n      p.pitch = Math.asin(speed > 1e-6 ? Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, p.velocity.y / speed)) : 0);\n      if (p.position.x < 1 || p.position.z < 1 || p.position.x > world.sizeX - 1 || p.position.z > world.sizeZ - 1 || p.position.y < 0 || p.position.y > world.sizeY) {\n        removed = true;\n      }\n    }\n    if (removed) dead.push(i);\n  }\n\n  for (let i = dead.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) projectiles.splice(dead[i], 1);\n}\n"
}
```

```json
  "content": "import { describe, expect, test } from \"bun:test\";\nimport * as THREE from \"three\";\nimport { spawnArrow } from \"@/lib/game/engine/projectiles\";\nimport type { GameState } from \"@/lib/game/engine/state\";\n\nfunction makeState(): GameState {\n  return { projectiles: [], nextProjectileId: 1 } as unknown as GameState;\n}\n\ndescribe(\"spawnArrow\", () => {\n  test(\"sets velocity = dir*speed, assigns sequential ids, and pushes the arrow\", () => {\n    const state = makeState();\n    const a = spawnArrow(state, 0, 10, 0, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1), { speed: 30, damage: 9, knockback: 0.5, fromPlayer: true, ttl: 4 });\n    expect(a.id).toBe(1);\n    expect(a.velocity.z).toBeCloseTo(-30, 5);\n    expect(a.damage).toBe(9);\n    expect(a.fromPlayer).toBe(true);\n    expect(state.projectiles).toHaveLength(1);\n\n    const b = spawnArrow(state, 0, 10, 0, new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), { speed: 20, damage: 4, knockback: 0.2, fromPlayer: false, ttl: 3 });\n    expect(b.id).toBe(2);\n    expect(b.velocity.x).toBeCloseTo(20, 5);\n    expect(b.fromPlayer).toBe(false);\n    expect(state.nextProjectileId).toBe(3);\n    expect(state.projectiles).toHaveLength(2);\n  });\n\n  test(\"normalizes the direction before applying speed\", () => {\n    const state = makeState();\n    const a = spawnArrow(state, 0, 0, 0, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -5), { speed: 10, damage: 1, knockback: 0, fromPlayer: true, ttl: 1 });\n    expect(a.velocity.length()).toBeCloseTo(10, 5);\n  });\n\n  test(\"spawns the arrow ahead of the muzzle so the firer never self-hits\", () => {\n    const state = makeState();\n    const a = spawnArrow(state, 0, 10, 0, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1), { speed: 10, damage: 1, knockback: 0, fromPlayer: true, ttl: 1 });\n    expect(a.position.z).toBeLessThan(0); // pushed forward along -z\n  });\n});\n"
}
```

Two test-geometry bugs (not logic bugs). The ttl test under-ticked, and the tunneling test placed the arrow exactly on an integer y-boundary, which makes the shared DDA take a spurious first step in Y — real arrows aren't axis-aligned, so I'll offset the test arrow off the boundary.

Arrows are transient\nsimulation entities — like mobs, they are never serialized.\n\ntickProjectiles integrates each arrow under gravity in capped substeps.\nBlock collision reuses the world DDA (voxelRaycast), which already sweeps\nthe whole segment, so even a very fast arrow can't tunnel a 1-block wall;\nthe entity test is substepped too so a fast arrow can't skip a thin mob\nbetween frames. A `fromPlayer` flag is the hit filter: player arrows hit\nmobs (with knockback, reusing the melee knockback shape), mob arrows hit\nthe player (armor-mitigated via applyDamageWithArmor). Spent arrows — hit,\nexpired, or out of bounds — despawn.\n\nWired after tickMobs in both the live and dead step branches so in-flight\narrows always clear (applyDamage no-ops while dead).\n\nNo save-format change: projectiles are session-only state.\nEOF\ngit log --oneline -1",

```json
}
```

```
122	export function createEmptySlot(): InventorySlot {
123	  return { id: null, label: "Empty", kind: null, count: 0 };
124	}
125	
126	export function createSlot(itemId: string, count: number): InventorySlot {
127	  const def = ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[itemId];
128	  if (!def) return createEmptySlot();
129	  const slot: InventorySlot = { ...def, count };
130	  if ((def.kind === "tool" || def.kind === "weapon" || def.kind === "armor") && def.maxDurability) {
131	    slot.maxDurability = def.maxDurability;
132	    slot.durability = def.maxDurability;
133	  }
134	  return slot;
135	}
136	
137	export function createInitialInventory(): InventorySlot[] {
138	  const slots: InventorySlot[] = Array.from({ length: INVENTORY_SLOTS }, () => createEmptySlot());
139	  const starter: Array<{ id: string; count: number }> = [
140	    { id: "grass", count: 64 },
141	    { id: "dirt", count: 64 },
142	    { id: "stone", count: 64 },
143	    { id: "wood", count: 64 },

149	  ];
150	  for (let i = 0; i < starter.length && i < slots.length; i += 1) slots[i] = createSlot(starter[i].id, starter[i].count);
151	  return slots;
152	}

183	/**
184	 * Items a broken block yields. The default is its single `BLOCK_TO_SLOT` entry;
185	 * grass occasionally also drops a seed (the natural seed source), and mature
186	 * wheat drops wheat plus 1–2 seeds. `rng` is injectable for deterministic tests.
187	 */
188	export function rollBlockDrops(block: BlockId, rng: () => number): Array<{ itemId: string; count: number }> {
189	  const drops: Array<{ itemId: string; count: number }> = [];
190	  const base = BLOCK_TO_SLOT[block];
191	  if (base) drops.push({ itemId: base, count: 1 });
192	
193	  if (block === BlockId.Grass && rng() < GRASS_SEED_DROP_CHANCE) {
194	    drops.push({ itemId: "seeds", count: 1 });
195	  }
196	  if (block === BlockId.WheatStage3) {
197	    drops.push({ itemId: "wheat", count: 1 });
198	    drops.push({ itemId: "seeds", count: 1 + Math.floor(rng() * 2) });
199	  }
200	  return drops;
201	}
```
