1	import { MAX_STACK_SIZE } from "@/lib/game/config";
2	import { ARMOR_SLOTS, createEmptySlot, createSlot, ITEM_DEF_BY_ID } from "@/lib/game/items";
3	import type { EquippedArmor, InventorySlot, Recipe } from "@/lib/game/types";
4	
5	/**
6	 * Pure inventory slot algebra. Every mutation returns a NEW slots array, or
7	 * null when the operation does not apply — callers keep the previous array on
8	 * null, so reference equality doubles as a change signal for React.
9	 */
10	
11	export function cloneSlots(slots: InventorySlot[]): InventorySlot[] {
12	  return slots.map((slot) => ({ ...slot }));
13	}
14	
15	export function countsById(slots: InventorySlot[]): Map<string, number> {
16	  const byId = new Map<string, number>();
17	  for (const slot of slots) {
18	    if (!slot.id || slot.count <= 0) continue;
19	    byId.set(slot.id, (byId.get(slot.id) ?? 0) + slot.count);
20	  }
21	  return byId;
22	}
23	
24	/**
25	 * Adds (delta > 0) or removes (delta < 0) items. Removal is all-or-nothing:
26	 * if the inventory holds fewer than |delta|, nothing is removed and null is
27	 * returned. Addition fills existing stacks, then empty slots; whatever does
28	 * not fit is dropped (a full inventory loses surplus block drops).
29	 */
30	export function adjustSlotCount(slots: InventorySlot[], slotId: string, delta: number, preferredIndex?: number): InventorySlot[] | null {
31	  if (!slotId || delta === 0) return null;
32	  const next = cloneSlots(slots);
33	  let remaining = Math.abs(delta);
34	
35	  if (delta < 0) {
36	    const consumeFromIndex = (index: number) => {
37	      if (remaining <= 0) return;
38	      if (index < 0 || index >= next.length) return;
39	      const slot = next[index];
40	      if (slot.id !== slotId || slot.count <= 0) return;
41	      const take = Math.min(remaining, slot.count);
42	      slot.count -= take;
43	      remaining -= take;
44	      if (slot.count <= 0) next[index] = createEmptySlot();
45	    };
46	
47	    if (typeof preferredIndex === "number") consumeFromIndex(preferredIndex);
48	    for (let i = 0; i < next.length && remaining > 0; i += 1) consumeFromIndex(i);
49	    if (remaining > 0) return null;
50	    return next;
51	  }
52	
53	  if (!ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[slotId]) return null;
54	
55	  const fillIndex = (index: number) => {
56	    if (remaining <= 0) return;
57	    if (index < 0 || index >= next.length) return;
58	    const slot = next[index];
59	    if (slot.id !== slotId || slot.count >= MAX_STACK_SIZE) return;
60	    const add = Math.min(remaining, MAX_STACK_SIZE - slot.count);
61	    slot.count += add;
62	    remaining -= add;
63	  };
64	
65	  if (typeof preferredIndex === "number") fillIndex(preferredIndex);
66	  for (let i = 0; i < next.length && remaining > 0; i += 1) fillIndex(i);
67	  for (let i = 0; i < next.length && remaining > 0; i += 1) {
68	    if (next[i].id !== null || next[i].count !== 0) continue;
69	    const add = Math.min(remaining, MAX_STACK_SIZE);
70	    next[i] = createSlot(slotId, add);
71	    remaining -= add;
72	  }
73	  return next;
74	}
75	
76	/** Wears the tool/weapon at `index` by `amount`; the slot empties at zero durability. */
77	export function consumeToolDurability(slots: InventorySlot[], index: number, amount = 1): InventorySlot[] | null {
78	  if (amount <= 0) return null;
79	  if (index < 0 || index >= slots.length) return null;
80	  const next = cloneSlots(slots);
81	  const slot = next[index];
82	  if ((slot.kind !== "tool" && slot.kind !== "weapon") || !slot.id || slot.count <= 0 || !slot.maxDurability) return null;
83	  const nextDurability = (slot.durability ?? slot.maxDurability) - amount;
84	  if (nextDurability <= 0) {
85	    next[index] = createEmptySlot();
86	    return next;
87	  }
88	  slot.durability = nextDurability;
89	  return next;
90	}
91	
92	/** Wears every equipped armor piece by `amount`; broken pieces disappear. */
93	export function consumeEquippedArmorDurability(slots: InventorySlot[], equipped: EquippedArmor, amount = 1): InventorySlot[] | null {
94	  if (amount <= 0) return null;
95	  const next = cloneSlots(slots);
96	  let changed = false;
97	  for (const armorSlot of ARMOR_SLOTS) {
98	    const equippedId = equipped[armorSlot];
99	    if (!equippedId) continue;
100	    const idx = next.findIndex((slot) => slot.id === equippedId && slot.kind === "armor" && slot.count > 0);
101	    if (idx < 0) continue;
102	    const slot = next[idx];
103	    if (!slot.maxDurability) continue;
104	    const nextDurability = (slot.durability ?? slot.maxDurability) - amount;
105	    if (nextDurability <= 0) next[idx] = createEmptySlot();
106	    else slot.durability = nextDurability;
107	    changed = true;
108	  }
109	  return changed ? next : null;
110	}
111	
112	export function canCraft(slots: InventorySlot[], recipe: Recipe): boolean {
113	  const byId = countsById(slots);
114	  const hasCost = recipe.cost.every((cost) => (byId.get(cost.slotId) ?? 0) >= cost.count);
115	  if (!hasCost) return false;
116	
117	  let freeForResult = 0;
118	  for (const slot of slots) {
119	    if (slot.id === recipe.result.slotId) freeForResult += MAX_STACK_SIZE - slot.count;
120	    if (slot.id === null && slot.count === 0) freeForResult += MAX_STACK_SIZE;
121	  }
122	  return freeForResult >= recipe.result.count;
123	}
124	
125	/**
126	 * Consumes the recipe cost and adds the result. Returns null unless the cost
127	 * is affordable AND the result fits — crafting never silently destroys the
128	 * overflow (this previously could happen when the inventory was full).
129	 */
130	export function craft(slots: InventorySlot[], recipe: Recipe): InventorySlot[] | null {
131	  if (!ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[recipe.result.slotId]) return null;
132	  if (!canCraft(slots, recipe)) return null;
133	
134	  const next = cloneSlots(slots);
135	  for (const cost of recipe.cost) {
136	    let remaining = cost.count;
137	    for (let i = 0; i < next.length && remaining > 0; i += 1) {
138	      if (next[i].id !== cost.slotId || next[i].count <= 0) continue;
139	      const take = Math.min(remaining, next[i].count);
140	      next[i].count -= take;
141	      remaining -= take;
142	      if (next[i].count <= 0) next[i] = createEmptySlot();
143	    }
144	  }
145	
146	  let remaining = recipe.result.count;
147	  for (let i = 0; i < next.length && remaining > 0; i += 1) {
148	    if (next[i].id !== recipe.result.slotId || next[i].count >= MAX_STACK_SIZE) continue;
149	    const add = Math.min(remaining, MAX_STACK_SIZE - next[i].count);
150	    next[i].count += add;
151	    remaining -= add;
152	  }
153	  for (let i = 0; i < next.length && remaining > 0; i += 1) {
154	    if (next[i].id !== null || next[i].count !== 0) continue;
155	    const add = Math.min(remaining, MAX_STACK_SIZE);
156	    next[i] = createSlot(recipe.result.slotId, add);
157	    remaining -= add;
158	  }
159	  return next;
160	}
161	
162	export function swapSlots(slots: InventorySlot[], fromIndex: number, toIndex: number): InventorySlot[] | null {
163	  if (fromIndex === toIndex) return null;
164	  if (fromIndex < 0 || toIndex < 0 || fromIndex >= slots.length || toIndex >= slots.length) return null;
165	  const next = cloneSlots(slots);
166	  const temp = next[fromIndex];
167	  next[fromIndex] = next[toIndex];
168	  next[toIndex] = temp;
169	  return next;
170	}
171	
172	/**
173	 * Swaps a slot between two (possibly identical) arrays — the cross-container
174	 * generalization of swapSlots, used to move items between the player inventory
175	 * and an open chest. When both refs point at the same array it degrades to a
176	 * plain swap and returns that one array as both `a` and `b`. Returns null on a
177	 * no-op or out-of-range index.
178	 */
179	export function moveStack(a: InventorySlot[], indexA: number, b: InventorySlot[], indexB: number): { a: InventorySlot[]; b: InventorySlot[] } | null {
180	  if (a === b) {
181	    const swapped = swapSlots(a, indexA, indexB);
182	    return swapped ? { a: swapped, b: swapped } : null;
183	  }
184	  if (indexA < 0 || indexA >= a.length || indexB < 0 || indexB >= b.length) return null;
185	  const nextA = cloneSlots(a);
186	  const nextB = cloneSlots(b);
187	  const temp = nextA[indexA];
188	  nextA[indexA] = nextB[indexB];
189	  nextB[indexB] = temp;
190	  return { a: nextA, b: nextB };
191	}
192	
193	/**
194	 * All-or-nothing insert of whole slot objects into `inventory` (used when a
195	 * broken chest spills its contents). Stackable items merge into existing stacks
196	 * then empty slots; durability items (tools/weapons/armor) take a whole empty
197	 * slot each so each piece keeps its own `durability`. Returns a new array, or
198	 * null if everything does not fit — the caller then leaves the inventory (and
199	 * the chest) untouched.
200	 */
201	export function tryInsertSlots(inventory: InventorySlot[], incoming: InventorySlot[]): InventorySlot[] | null {
202	  const next = cloneSlots(inventory);
203	
204	  const insertStackable = (id: string, count: number): boolean => {
205	    let remaining = count;
206	    for (let i = 0; i < next.length && remaining > 0; i += 1) {
207	      const slot = next[i];
208	      if (slot.id !== id || slot.count >= MAX_STACK_SIZE) continue;
209	      const add = Math.min(remaining, MAX_STACK_SIZE - slot.count);
210	      slot.count += add;
211	      remaining -= add;
212	    }
213	    for (let i = 0; i < next.length && remaining > 0; i += 1) {
214	      if (next[i].id !== null || next[i].count !== 0) continue;
215	      const add = Math.min(remaining, MAX_STACK_SIZE);
216	      next[i] = createSlot(id, add);
217	      remaining -= add;
218	    }
219	    return remaining === 0;
220	  };
221	
222	  const insertDurable = (slot: InventorySlot): boolean => {
223	    let remaining = slot.count;
224	    for (let i = 0; i < next.length && remaining > 0; i += 1) {
225	      if (next[i].id !== null || next[i].count !== 0) continue;
226	      next[i] = { ...slot, count: 1 };
227	      remaining -= 1;
228	    }
229	    return remaining === 0;
230	  };
231	
232	  for (const slot of incoming) {
233	    if (!slot.id || slot.count <= 0) continue;
234	    const def = ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[slot.id];
235	    if (!def) continue; // unknown ids carry no data to preserve
236	    const placed = def.maxDurability ? insertDurable(slot) : insertStackable(slot.id, slot.count);
237	    if (!placed) return null;
238	  }
239	
240	  return next;
241	}
242	
243	/** Toggles the armor piece at `index` in its armor slot. */
244	export function toggleEquipArmor(slots: InventorySlot[], equipped: EquippedArmor, index: number): EquippedArmor | null {
245	  if (index < 0 || index >= slots.length) return null;
246	  const slot = slots[index];
247	  if (slot.kind !== "armor" || !slot.id || !slot.armorSlot || slot.count <= 0) return null;
248	  const next = { ...equipped };
249	  next[slot.armorSlot] = equipped[slot.armorSlot] === slot.id ? null : slot.id;
250	  return next;
251	}
252	
253	/** Unequips armor pieces no longer present in the inventory (broken or dropped). */
254	export function unequipMissingArmor(slots: InventorySlot[], equipped: EquippedArmor): EquippedArmor | null {
255	  let changed = false;
256	  const next = { ...equipped };
257	  for (const armorSlot of ARMOR_SLOTS) {
258	    const equippedId = next[armorSlot];
259	    if (!equippedId) continue;
260	    const stillOwned = slots.some((slot) => slot.id === equippedId && slot.count > 0);
261	    if (stillOwned) continue;
262	    next[armorSlot] = null;
263	    changed = true;
264	  }
265	  return changed ? next : null;
266	}
267	
268	/** Total defense points from equipped, still-owned armor (drives the HUD armor bar). */
269	export function equippedDefense(slots: InventorySlot[], equipped: EquippedArmor): number {
270	  let defense = 0;
271	  for (const armorSlot of ARMOR_SLOTS) {
272	    const equippedId = equipped[armorSlot];
273	    if (!equippedId) continue;
274	    const def = ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[equippedId];
275	    if (!def || def.kind !== "armor" || def.armorSlot !== armorSlot) continue;
276	    const hasOwnedPiece = slots.some((slot) => slot.id === equippedId && slot.count > 0);
277	    if (!hasOwnedPiece) continue;
278	    defense += def.defense ?? 0;
279	  }
280	  return defense;
281	}
282	
283	/** Damage reduction from equipped, still-owned armor: 5% per defense point, capped at 75%. */
284	export function armorReduction(slots: InventorySlot[], equipped: EquippedArmor): number {
285	  return Math.min(0.75, equippedDefense(slots, equipped) * 0.05);
286	}

1	import { BLOCK_COLORS, BlockId } from "@/lib/world";
2	import { ITEM_DEF_BY_ID } from "@/lib/game/items";
3	
4	/**
5	 * Procedural 16x16 pixel-art sprites for inventory icons. Pure pixel-buffer
6	 * code with no DOM or Three.js so it runs under bun test; the canvas/data-URL
7	 * step lives in sprites.ts. Item shapes are string grids painted through a
8	 * material palette; block items render as a shaded isometric cube using the
9	 * same BLOCK_COLORS palette as the world atlas (read-only import).
10	 */
11	
12	export const SPRITE_SIZE = 16;
13	
14	export type Rgb = [number, number, number];
15	export type PixelPalette = Record<string, Rgb>;
16	
17	/** Paints a 16-row string grid into RGBA pixels. "." and " " are transparent. */
18	export function paintGrid(grid: string[], palette: PixelPalette): Uint8ClampedArray {
19	  const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(SPRITE_SIZE * SPRITE_SIZE * 4);
20	  for (let y = 0; y < SPRITE_SIZE; y += 1) {
21	    const row = grid[y] ?? "";
22	    for (let x = 0; x < SPRITE_SIZE; x += 1) {
23	      const ch = row[x] ?? ".";
24	      if (ch === "." || ch === " ") continue;
25	      const rgb = palette[ch];
26	      if (!rgb) continue;
27	      const i = (y * SPRITE_SIZE + x) * 4;
28	      out[i] = rgb[0];
29	      out[i + 1] = rgb[1];
30	      out[i + 2] = rgb[2];
31	      out[i + 3] = 255;
32	    }
33	  }
34	  return out;
35	}
36	
37	// Deterministic per-pixel hash for texture noise (same idea as the atlas).
38	function pixelHash(x: number, y: number, salt: number): number {
39	  const v = Math.sin(x * 12.9898 + y * 78.233 + salt * 37.719) * 43758.5453;
40	  return v - Math.floor(v);
41	}
42	
43	const clampByte = (v: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(v)));

525	// Ore accent colors sprinkled over the stone cube (mirrors the atlas sparkle).
526	const ORE_ACCENTS: Partial<Record<BlockId, Rgb>> = {
527	  [BlockId.SliverOre]: [222, 226, 233],
528	  [BlockId.RubyOre]: [220, 68, 84],
529	  [BlockId.GoldOre]: [244, 196, 72],
530	  [BlockId.SapphireOre]: [70, 140, 230],
531	  [BlockId.DiamondOre]: [140, 235, 244]
532	};
533	
534	function blockRgb(blockId: BlockId): Rgb {
535	  const float = BLOCK_COLORS[blockId] ?? [0.6, 0.6, 0.6];
536	  return [float[0] * 255, float[1] * 255, float[2] * 255];
537	}
538	
539	/**
540	 * Shaded isometric cube for a block item: bright top diamond, mid left face,
541	 * dark right face, with per-pixel noise. Grass gets dirt sides with a grass
542	 * lip; ores get accent speckles.
543	 */
544	export function paintIsoBlock(blockId: BlockId): Uint8ClampedArray {
545	  const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(SPRITE_SIZE * SPRITE_SIZE * 4);
546	  const accent = ORE_ACCENTS[blockId];
547	  const topColor = blockRgb(blockId);
548	  const sideColor = blockId === BlockId.Grass ? blockRgb(BlockId.Dirt) : topColor;
549	
550	  for (let x = 0; x < SPRITE_SIZE; x += 1) {
551	    const px = x + 0.5;
552	    const onLeft = px <= 8;
553	    // Distance 0..1 from the outer vertex toward the center column.
554	    const dx = onLeft ? (px - 0.5) / 7.5 : (15.5 - px) / 7.5;
555	    const topY = 4 - dx * 3.5; // edge from a side vertex up to the top vertex
556	    const midY = 4 + dx * 3.5; // edge from a side vertex down to the bottom of the top face
557	    const botY = midY + 8;
558	
559	    for (let y = 0; y < SPRITE_SIZE; y += 1) {
560	      const py = y + 0.5;
561	      if (py < topY || py >= botY) continue;
562	      const onTop = py < midY;
563	
564	      let rgb: Rgb;
565	      let shade: number;
566	      if (onTop) {
567	        rgb = topColor;
568	        shade = 1.18;
569	      } else if (blockId === BlockId.Grass && py < midY + 1.6) {
570	        rgb = topColor; // grass lip at the top of the side faces
571	        shade = onLeft ? 0.86 : 0.62;
572	      } else {
573	        rgb = sideColor;
574	        shade = onLeft ? 0.82 : 0.56;
575	      }
576	
577	      const noise = 0.92 + pixelHash(x, y, blockId) * 0.16;
578	      if (accent && !onTop && pixelHash(x * 3 + 1, y * 3 + 2, blockId) > 0.82) {
579	        rgb = accent;
580	      }
581	      const i = (y * SPRITE_SIZE + x) * 4;
582	      out[i] = clampByte(rgb[0] * shade * noise);
583	      out[i + 1] = clampByte(rgb[1] * shade * noise);
584	      out[i + 2] = clampByte(rgb[2] * shade * noise);
585	      out[i + 3] = 255;
586	    }
587	  }
588	  return out;
589	}
590	
591	function materialFor(itemId: string): { m: Rgb; M: Rgb; l: Rgb } {
592	  const prefix = itemId.split("_")[0];
593	  return MATERIAL_PALETTES[prefix] ?? STEEL;
594	}
595	
596	/** 16x16 RGBA pixels for any item id; magenta checker for unknown ids. */
597	export function renderSpritePixels(itemId: string): Uint8ClampedArray {
598	  const def = ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[itemId];
599	  const custom = ITEM_SPRITE_GRIDS[itemId];
600	  if (custom) return paintGrid(custom.grid, custom.palette);
601	  if (def?.kind === "block" && def.blockId !== undefined) return paintIsoBlock(def.blockId);
602	  if (def?.kind === "tool" && itemId.endsWith("_hoe")) return paintGrid(HOE_GRID, toolPalette(materialFor(itemId)));
603	  if (def?.kind === "tool") return paintGrid(PICKAXE_GRID, toolPalette(materialFor(itemId)));
604	  if (def?.kind === "weapon") {
605	    if (itemId === "knife") return paintGrid(KNIFE_GRID, toolPalette(STEEL));
606	    return paintGrid(SWORD_GRID, toolPalette(materialFor(itemId)));
607	  }
608	  if (def?.kind === "armor" && def.armorSlot) {
609	    return paintGrid(ARMOR_GRIDS[def.armorSlot] ?? UNKNOWN_GRID, { m: STEEL.m, M: STEEL.M, l: STEEL.l });
610	  }
611	  return paintGrid(UNKNOWN_GRID, { p: [240, 40, 240], P: [40, 8, 40] });
612	}
613

};

  geometries: THREE.BufferGeometry[];
};

/** A persisted inventory/container slot: just enough to rebuild it on load. */
export type SavedSlot = { id: string | null; count: number; durability?: number };

Returns\n * false (no shot) when the bow is on cooldown or the player has no arrows — the\n * caller has already confirmed a bow is held via isBow, so a bow never melees.\n */\nexport function tryFireBow(state: GameState, emit: EmitGameEvent): boolean {\n  const slot = state.inventory[state.selectedSlot];\n  if (!isBow(slot)) return false;\n  if (state.timers.bowCooldownTimer > 0) return false;\n  if ((countsById(state.inventory).get(\"arrow\") ?? 0) < 1) return false;\n\n  const { position, yaw, pitch } = state.player;\n  scratchOrigin.set(position.x, position.y + EYE_HEIGHT, position.z);\n  lookDirection(yaw, pitch, scratchForward);\n  spawnArrow(state, scratchOrigin.x, scratchOrigin.y, scratchOrigin.z, scratchForward, {\n    speed: ARROW_SPEED,\n    damage: BOW_ARROW_DAMAGE,\n    knockback: BOW_KNOCKBACK,\n    fromPlayer: true,\n    ttl: ARROW_TTL\n  });\n\n  state.inventory = adjustSlotCount(state.inventory, \"arrow\", -1) ?? state.inventory;\n  state.inventory = consumeToolDurability(state.inventory, state.selectedSlot, BOW_DURABILITY_PER_SHOT) ?? state.inventory;\n  state.timers.bowCooldownTimer = BOW_COOLDOWN_SECONDS;\n  emit({ type: \"bowFired\" });\n  return true;\n}"
}

  "new_string": "import * as THREE from \"three\";\nimport { voxelRaycast } from \"@/lib/world\";\nimport {\n  ARROW_TTL,\n  HOSTILE_BURN_ABOVE_DAYLIGHT,\n  MOB_ARROW_KNOCKBACK,\n  SKELETON_ARROW_DAMAGE,\n  SKELETON_ARROW_SPEED,\n  SKELETON_FIRE_VGAP,\n  SKELETON_LEAD_FACTOR,\n  SKELETON_STANDOFF_MAX,\n  SKELETON_STANDOFF_MIN,\n  SPIDER_AGGRO_BELOW_DAYLIGHT\n} from \"@/lib/game/config\";\nimport { MOB_TEMPLATES } from \"@/lib/game/mobs\";\nimport type { EmitGameEvent, GameState, MobState } from \"../state\";\nimport { spawnArrow } from \"../projectiles\";\nimport type { SurfaceYAtFn } from \"@/lib/game/spawn\";\n\n// Scratch vectors — per-frame tick over every mob must not allocate.\nconst UP = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);\nconst scratchToPlayer = new THREE.Vector3();\nconst scratchToPlayer3D = new THREE.Vector3();\nconst scratchMobEye = new THREE.Vector3();\nconst scratchPlayerAim = new THREE.Vector3();\nconst scratchRay = new THREE.Vector3();\nconst scratchAim = new THREE.Vector3();\n\n/**\n * A ranged mob looses an arrow from its eye toward the player's chest, leading a\n * moving target by a fraction of the arrow's travel time. The arrow is not\n * player-owned, so it only ever hits the player (never the firer or other mobs).\n */\nfunction fireMobArrow(state: GameState, mob: MobState, damage: number, speed: number, emit: EmitGameEvent): void {\n  const { player } = state;\n  const eyeY = mob.position.y + mob.halfHeight * 0.7;\n  const dist = Math.hypot(player.position.x - mob.position.x, player.position.z - mob.position.z);\n  const lead = (dist / speed) * SKELETON_LEAD_FACTOR;\n  scratchAim.set(\n    player.position.x + player.velocity.x * lead - mob.position.x,\n    player.position.y + 0.9 - eyeY,\n    player.position.z + player.velocity.z * lead - mob.position.z\n  );\n  spawnArrow(state, mob.position.x, eyeY, mob.position.z, scratchAim, {\n    speed,\n    damage,\n    knockback: MOB_ARROW_KNOCKBACK,\n    fromPlayer: false,\n    ttl: ARROW_TTL\n  });\n  emit({ type: \"mobAttacked\", kind: mob.kind });\n}"

  "content": "import { describe, expect, test } from \"bun:test\";\nimport * as THREE from \"three\";\nimport { VoxelWorld } from \"@/lib/world\";\nimport { mobHalfHeight } from \"@/lib/game/mobs\";\nimport { createTimers, type GameEvent, type GameState, type MobState } from \"@/lib/game/engine/state\";\nimport { tickMobs, type MobTickDeps } from \"@/lib/game/engine/systems/mobAI\";\nimport type { MobKind } from \"@/lib/game/types\";\n\nfunction makeMob(kind: MobKind, x: number, y: number, z: number, attackTimer = 0): MobState {\n  return {\n    id: 1,\n    kind,\n    hostile: true,\n    hp: 9,\n    position: new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z),\n    direction: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1),\n    yaw: 0,\n    turnTimer: 5,\n    speed: 1.08,\n    moveSpeed: 1.08,\n    detectRange: kind === \"zombie\" ? 11 : 12,\n    attackDamage: 3,\n    attackCooldown: 1.8,\n    attackTimer,\n    halfHeight: mobHalfHeight(kind),\n    bobSeed: 0,\n    fedTimer: 0,\n    ageTimer: 0\n  };\n}\n\nfunction makeState(mobs: MobState[]): GameState {\n  return {\n    world: new VoxelWorld(48, 48, 48, 1),\n    mobs,\n    projectiles: [],\n    nextProjectileId: 1,\n    daylight: 0.1, // night-ish so hostiles stay active and don't burn\n    player: { position: new THREE.Vector3(24, 30, 24), velocity: new THREE.Vector3(), yaw: 0, pitch: 0, onGround: true }\n  } as unknown as GameState;\n}\n\nfunction makeDeps() {\n  const events: GameEvent[] = [];\n  let damage = 0;\n  const deps: MobTickDeps = {\n    surfaceYAt: () => 29, // keeps mob.y ≈ player.y so the vertical gap stays small\n    applyDamage: (a: number) => {\n      damage += a;\n    },\n    removeMobAt: () => {},\n    rng: () => 0.5,\n    emit: (e: GameEvent) => events.push(e)\n  };\n  return { deps, events, getDamage: () => damage };\n}\n\ndescribe(\"ranged skeletons\", () => {\n  test(\"a skeleton with line of sight fires an arrow and re-arms its cooldown\", () => {\n    const skeleton = makeMob(\"skeleton\", 24, 30, 17); // ~7 blocks away, in the standoff band\n    const state = makeState([skeleton]);\n    const { deps, events } = makeDeps();\n\n    tickMobs(state, 0.05, deps);\n\n    expect(state.projectiles).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(state.projectiles[0].fromPlayer).toBe(false);\n    expect(skeleton.attackTimer).toBeCloseTo(skeleton.attackCooldown, 5);\n    expect(events.some((e) => e.type === \"mobAttacked\" && e.kind === \"skeleton\")).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  test(\"a skeleton kites away when the player is too close\", () => {\n    const skeleton = makeMob(\"skeleton\", 24, 30, 21, 1); // 3 blocks away (< standoff min), cooldown not ready\n    const state = makeState([skeleton]);\n    const { deps } = makeDeps();\n    const startZ = skeleton.position.z;\n\n    tickMobs(state, 0.05, deps);\n\n    // Player is at z=24; backing away means moving toward smaller z.\n    expect(skeleton.position.z).toBeLessThan(startZ);\n  });\n\n  test(\"a zombie still melees and shoots nothing\", () => {\n    const zombie = makeMob(\"zombie\", 24, 30, 21.5); // ~2.5 blocks, within melee reach\n    const state = makeState([zombie]);\n    const { deps, events, getDamage } = makeDeps();\n\n    tickMobs(state, 0.05, deps);\n\n    expect(state.projectiles).toHaveLength(0);\n    expect(getDamage()).toBe(3); // melee damage applied\n    expect(events.some((e) => e.type === \"mobAttacked\" && e.kind === \"zombie\")).toBe(true);\n  });\n});\n"
}

320	  private syncCamera(state: GameState): void {
321	    const { position, yaw, pitch } = state.player;
322	    scratchEye.set(position.x, position.y + EYE_HEIGHT, position.z);
323	
324	    let distance = 0;
325	    if (state.cameraMode !== "first") {
326	      // Clamp the boom against terrain so walls never occlude the player.
327	      const dir = cameraOffsetDirection(state.cameraMode, yaw, pitch, scratchDir);
328	      const hit = voxelRaycast(state.world, scratchEye, dir, THIRD_PERSON_DISTANCE);
329	      distance = hit ? Math.max(0, hit.distance - THIRD_PERSON_MARGIN) : THIRD_PERSON_DISTANCE;
330	    }
331	
332	    const pose = computeCameraPose(state.cameraMode, scratchEye.x, scratchEye.y, scratchEye.z, yaw, pitch, distance, scratchPose);
333	    this.camera.position.set(pose.posX, pose.posY, pose.posZ);
334	    this.camera.rotation.order = "YXZ";
335	    this.camera.rotation.y = pose.yaw;
336	    this.camera.rotation.x = pose.pitch;
337	  }

339	  private syncWorldMesh(state: GameState): void {
340	    const regionX = Math.floor(state.player.position.x / RENDER_GRID) * RENDER_GRID;
341	    const regionZ = Math.floor(state.player.position.z / RENDER_GRID) * RENDER_GRID;
342	    if (!state.worldMeshDirty && regionX === this.currentRegionX && regionZ === this.currentRegionZ) return;
343	
344	    state.worldMeshDirty = false;
345	    this.currentRegionX = regionX;
346	    this.currentRegionZ = regionZ;
347	
348	    this.rebuildWorldMesh(state.world, regionX, regionZ);
349	  }

351	  private rebuildWorldMesh(world: VoxelWorld, regionX: number, regionZ: number): void {
352	    const geometry = buildGeometryRegion(world, regionX - RENDER_RADIUS, regionX + RENDER_RADIUS, regionZ - RENDER_RADIUS, regionZ + RENDER_RADIUS);
353	    this.scene.remove(this.worldMesh);
354	    this.worldMesh.geometry.dispose();
355	    this.worldMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, this.worldMaterial);
356	    this.scene.add(this.worldMesh);
357	  }
358	
359	  private syncDayNight(state: GameState): void {
360	    const sunAngle = sunAngleAt(state.dayClock);
361	    const daylight = state.daylight;
362	
363	    this.sun.position.set(Math.cos(sunAngle) * 110, Math.sin(sunAngle) * 108, Math.sin(sunAngle * 0.7) * 80);
364	    this.sun.intensity = 0.2 + daylight * 1.2;
365	    this.hemiLight.intensity = 0.24 + daylight * 1.05;
366	
367	    this.liveSky.copy(this.nightSky).lerp(this.daySky, daylight);
368	
369	    // Overcast: precipitation pulls the sky toward gray, dims the light, and
370	    // draws the fog in for an enclosed feel. Cosmetic — daylight itself is unchanged.
371	    const overcast = state.weather.kind === "clear" ? 0 : state.weather.intensity;
372	    if (overcast > 0) {
373	      this.liveSky.lerp(this.overcastGray, overcast * 0.6);
374	      this.sun.intensity *= 1 - overcast * 0.5;
375	      this.hemiLight.intensity *= 1 - overcast * 0.35;
376	    }
377	    this.scene.fog?.color.copy(this.liveSky);
378	    if (this.scene.fog instanceof THREE.Fog) this.scene.fog.far = 200 - overcast * 90;
379	  }
380	}

1	import * as THREE from "three";
2	import { BABY_SCALE } from "@/lib/game/config";
3	import { createMobModelForKind } from "@/lib/game/mobs";
4	import type { MobModel } from "@/lib/game/types";
5	import type { MobState } from "@/lib/game/engine/state";
6	
7	export type MobVisuals = {
8	  /** Creates/removes models to match the mob list and animates bob + gait. */
9	  sync(mobs: MobState[], timeMs: number): void;
10	  dispose(): void;
11	};
12	
13	export function createMobVisuals(scene: THREE.Scene): MobVisuals {
14	  const models = new Map<number, MobModel>();
15	  const seen = new Set<number>();
16	
17	  const removeModel = (id: number) => {
18	    const model = models.get(id);
19	    if (!model) return;
20	    scene.remove(model.group);
21	    for (const material of model.materials) material.dispose();
22	    for (const geometry of model.geometries) geometry.dispose();
23	    models.delete(id);
24	  };
25	
26	  return {
27	    sync(mobs, timeMs) {
28	      seen.clear();
29	      for (const mob of mobs) {
30	        seen.add(mob.id);
31	        let model = models.get(mob.id);
32	        if (!model) {
33	          model = createMobModelForKind(mob.kind);
34	          models.set(mob.id, model);
35	          scene.add(model.group);
36	        }
37	
38	        const bob = Math.sin(timeMs * 0.008 + mob.bobSeed) * 0.04;
39	        model.group.position.set(mob.position.x, mob.position.y + bob, mob.position.z);
40	        model.group.rotation.y = mob.yaw;
41	        model.group.scale.setScalar(mob.ageTimer > 0 ? BABY_SCALE : 1);
42	
43	        const gait = Math.sin(timeMs * 0.015 * mob.moveSpeed + mob.bobSeed) * 0.3;
44	        if (model.legs.length === 4) {
45	          model.legs[0].rotation.x = gait;
46	          model.legs[1].rotation.x = -gait;
47	          model.legs[2].rotation.x = -gait;
48	          model.legs[3].rotation.x = gait;
49	        }
50	      }
51	
52	      for (const id of models.keys()) {
53	        if (!seen.has(id)) removeModel(id);
54	      }
55	    },
56	
57	    dispose() {
58	      for (const id of [...models.keys()]) removeModel(id);
59	    }
60	  };
61	}
62

1	import * as THREE from "three";
2	
3	/**
4	 * Extrudes a 16x16 RGBA sprite (from renderSpritePixels) into a thin voxel
5	 * mesh: every opaque pixel becomes a pixel-thick box, merged into one
6	 * triangle-soup geometry with vertex colors (same style as world meshing).
7	 * Front/back faces always render; side faces only where the neighbouring
8	 * pixel is transparent, so the silhouette outline is the only side geometry.
9	 */
10	
11	// Per-axis brightness baked into vertex colors so the flat model reads as 3D.
12	const SHADE_FRONT_BACK = 1.0;
13	const SHADE_TOP_BOTTOM = 0.85;
14	const SHADE_LEFT_RIGHT = 0.7;
15	
16	export function buildExtrudedSpriteGeometry(pixels: Uint8ClampedArray, size = 16, pixelSize = 0.03, depth = 0.03): THREE.BufferGeometry {
17	  const positions: number[] = [];
18	  const normals: number[] = [];
19	  const colors: number[] = [];
20	
21	  const opaque = (x: number, y: number): boolean => {
22	    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= size || y >= size) return false;
23	    return pixels[(y * size + x) * 4 + 3] > 0;
24	  };
25	
26	  const half = (size * pixelSize) / 2;
27	  const halfDepth = depth / 2;
28	
29	  // Quad corners wind counter-clockwise as seen from outside (along +normal).
30	  const pushQuad = (corners: [number, number, number][], normal: [number, number, number], rgb: [number, number, number], shade: number) => {
31	    const order = [0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3];
32	    for (const i of order) {
33	      positions.push(corners[i][0], corners[i][1], corners[i][2]);
34	      normals.push(normal[0], normal[1], normal[2]);
35	      colors.push((rgb[0] / 255) * shade, (rgb[1] / 255) * shade, (rgb[2] / 255) * shade);
36	    }
37	  };
38	
39	  for (let y = 0; y < size; y += 1) {
40	    for (let x = 0; x < size; x += 1) {
41	      if (!opaque(x, y)) continue;
42	      const i = (y * size + x) * 4;
43	      const rgb: [number, number, number] = [pixels[i], pixels[i + 1], pixels[i + 2]];
44	
45	      // Grid row 0 is the top of the sprite; geometry is centered at the origin.
46	      const x0 = x * pixelSize - half;
47	      const x1 = x0 + pixelSize;
48	      const y1 = half - y * pixelSize;
49	      const y0 = y1 - pixelSize;
50	      const z0 = -halfDepth;
51	      const z1 = halfDepth;
52	
53	      pushQuad(
54	        [
55	          [x0, y0, z1],
56	          [x1, y0, z1],
57	          [x1, y1, z1],
58	          [x0, y1, z1]
59	        ],
60	        [0, 0, 1],
61	        rgb,
62	        SHADE_FRONT_BACK
63	      );
64	      pushQuad(
65	        [
66	          [x1, y0, z0],
67	          [x0, y0, z0],
68	          [x0, y1, z0],
69	          [x1, y1, z0]
70	        ],
71	        [0, 0, -1],
72	        rgb,
73	        SHADE_FRONT_BACK
74	      );
75	      if (!opaque(x, y - 1)) {
76	        pushQuad(
77	          [
78	            [x0, y1, z1],
79	            [x1, y1, z1],
80	            [x1, y1, z0],
81	            [x0, y1, z0]
82	          ],
83	          [0, 1, 0],
84	          rgb,
85	          SHADE_TOP_BOTTOM
86	        );
87	      }
88	      if (!opaque(x, y + 1)) {
89	        pushQuad(
90	          [
91	            [x0, y0, z0],
92	            [x1, y0, z0],
93	            [x1, y0, z1],
94	            [x0, y0, z1]
95	          ],
96	          [0, -1, 0],
97	          rgb,
98	          SHADE_TOP_BOTTOM
99	        );
100	      }
101	      if (!opaque(x - 1, y)) {
102	        pushQuad(
103	          [
104	            [x0, y0, z0],
105	            [x0, y0, z1],
106	            [x0, y1, z1],
107	            [x0, y1, z0]
108	          ],
109	          [-1, 0, 0],
110	          rgb,
111	          SHADE_LEFT_RIGHT
112	        );
113	      }
114	      if (!opaque(x + 1, y)) {
115	        pushQuad(
116	          [
117	            [x1, y0, z1],
118	            [x1, y0, z0],
119	            [x1, y1, z0],
120	            [x1, y1, z1]
121	          ],
122	          [1, 0, 0],
123	          rgb,
124	          SHADE_LEFT_RIGHT
125	        );
126	      }
127	    }
128	  }
129	
130	  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
131	  geometry.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
132	  geometry.setAttribute("normal", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
133	  geometry.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
134	  geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
135	  return geometry;
136	}

7	export type ItemModel = {
8	  object: THREE.Object3D;
9	  geometry: THREE.BufferGeometry;
10	  material: THREE.Material;
11	};
12	
13	const blockColor = (blockId: number | undefined): number =>
14	  (blockId !== undefined ? HELD_BLOCK_COLORS[blockId as keyof typeof HELD_BLOCK_COLORS] : undefined) ?? HELD_BLOCK_FALLBACK_COLOR;
15	
16	/**
17	 * Builds the 3D model for an inventory item — shared between the first-person
18	 * held-item overlay and the third-person hand. The caller owns disposal of the
19	 * returned geometry and material. Returns null for empty/invalid slots.
20	 */
21	export function buildItemModel(slot: InventorySlot | undefined): ItemModel | null {
22	  if (!slot?.id || slot.count <= 0 || !slot.kind) return null;
23	
24	  if (slot.kind === "block") {
25	    const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.22, 0.22, 0.22);
26	    const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: blockColor(slot.blockId), roughness: 0.7, metalness: 0.05 });
27	    return { object: new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material), geometry, material };
28	  }
29	
30	  // Tools, weapons, food, armor: extrude the same 16x16 pixel grid the
31	  // inventory icon uses, so the in-hand model always matches the sprite.
32	  const geometry = buildExtrudedSpriteGeometry(renderSpritePixels(slot.id));
33	  const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.7, metalness: 0.05 });
34	  return { object: new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material), geometry, material };
35	}

76	/** The production graph: zzfx + AudioContext, imported only inside a gesture. */
77	async function createDefaultGraph(): Promise<AudioGraph> {
78	  // zzfx instantiates its own module-scope AudioContext on import, so the
79	  // import itself must wait for the unlock gesture (autoplay policy, SSR).
80	  const { ZZFX } = await import("zzfx");
81	  const ctx = new AudioContext();
82	  const compressor = ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();
83	  compressor.connect(ctx.destination);
84	  const masterGain = ctx.createGain();
85	  masterGain.connect(compressor);
86	  const sfxGain = ctx.createGain();
87	  sfxGain.connect(masterGain);
88	  const musicGain = ctx.createGain();
89	  musicGain.connect(masterGain);
90	
91	  const backend = createSynthBackend(ctx, sfxGain, (...params) => ZZFX.buildSamples(...params), ZZFX.sampleRate);
92	  const music = createMusicPlayer(ctx, musicGain, createMusicBrain());
93	  const rain = createRainLoop(ctx, masterGain);
94	
95	  return {
96	    backend,
97	    music,
98	    rain,
99	    setVolumes(master, musicVolume) {
100	      masterGain.gain.value = master;
101	      musicGain.gain.value = musicVolume;
102	    },
103	    resume() {
104	      if (ctx.state === "suspended") void ctx.resume();
105	    },
106	    dispose() {
107	      rain.dispose();
108	      music.dispose();
109	      backend.dispose();
110	      void ctx.close();
111	    }
112	  };
113	}

120	export function createAudioDirector(deps: AudioDirectorDeps = {}): AudioDirector {
121	  const createGraph = deps.createGraph ?? createDefaultGraph;
122	  const footsteps = createFootstepScheduler();
123	  const mobAmbience = createMobAmbienceScheduler(deps.rng);

125	  let graph: AudioGraph | null = null;
126	  let unlocking = false;
127	  let disposed = false;
128	  let settings = DEFAULT_AUDIO_SETTINGS;
129	
130	  // Continuous-sound trackers, all derived from state in sync().
131	  let lastX = 0;
132	  let lastZ = 0;
133	  let hasLastPosition = false;
134	  let miningKey = "";
135	  let miningStage = 0;
136	  let miningTickSound = HIT_TICK_SOUNDS.stone;
137	  let miningHardness = 2;
138	  let stableBiome = BiomeId.Plains;
139	  let pendingBiome = BiomeId.Plains;
140	  let pendingBiomeSeconds = 0;
141	  let ducked = false;
142	
143	  const applyVolumes = (): void => {
144	    graph?.setVolumes(settings.muted ? 0 : settings.master, (ducked ? PAUSE_DUCK : 1) * settings.music);
145	  };
146	
147	  const surfaceGroupUnder = (state: GameState, fx: number, fy: number, fz: number) => {
148	    let block = state.world.get(fx, fy - 1, fz) as BlockId;
149	    if (block === BlockId.Air) block = state.world.get(fx, fy - 2, fz) as BlockId;
150	    return materialGroupFor(block);
151	  };
152	
153	  return {
154	    unlock() {
155	      if (disposed || graph || unlocking) {
156	        graph?.resume();
157	        return;
158	      }
159	      unlocking = true;
160	      void Promise.resolve(createGraph())
161	        .then((created) => {
162	          if (disposed) {
163	            created.dispose();
164	            return;
165	          }
166	          graph = created;
167	          // The constructor gesture may have expired by this microtask —
168	          // resume explicitly so the context reliably leaves "suspended".
169	          created.resume();
170	          applyVolumes();
171	        })
172	        .catch(() => {
173	          // Audio stays optional; the next gesture retries from scratch.
174	        })
175	        .finally(() => {
176	          unlocking = false;
177	        });
178	    },
179	
180	    handleEvent(event) {
181	      const backend = graph?.backend;
182	      if (!backend) return;
183	      switch (event.type) {
184	        case "blockBroken":
185	          backend.play(BREAK_SOUNDS[materialGroupFor(event.blockId)]);
186	          break;
187	        case "blockPlaced":
188	          backend.play(PLACE_SOUNDS[materialGroupFor(event.blockId)]);
189	          break;
190	        case "playerHurt":
191	          backend.play(HURT_SOUND);
192	          break;
193	        case "ateFood":
194	          backend.play(EAT_SOUND);
195	          break;
196	        case "jumped":
197	          backend.play(JUMP_SOUND);
198	          break;
199	        case "landed":
200	          backend.play(LAND_SOUND, { gain: Math.min(1.2, Math.max(0.3, event.impact / FULL_LANDING_IMPACT)) });
201	          break;
202	        case "mobAttacked":
203	          backend.play(MOB_ATTACK_SOUNDS[event.kind]);
204	          break;
205	        case "mobHit":
206	          backend.play(MOB_HIT_SOUND);
207	          break;
208	        case "mobDied":
209	          backend.play(MOB_DEATH_SOUND);
210	          break;
211	        case "mobSpawned":
212	          backend.play(MOB_SPAWN_SOUND);
213	          break;
214	        case "died":
215	          backend.play(DEATH_SOUND);
216	          break;
217	        case "respawned":
218	          backend.play(RESPAWN_SOUND);
219	          break;
220	        case "sleepStarted":
221	          backend.play(SLEEP_SOUND);
222	          break;
223	        case "wokeUp":
224	          backend.play(WAKE_SOUND);
225	          break;
226	        case "tilledSoil":
227	          backend.play(TILL_SOUND);
228	          break;
229	        case "plantedSeed":
230	          backend.play(PLANT_SOUND);
231	          break;
232	        case "smelted":
233	          backend.play(SMELT_SOUND);
234	          break;
235	        case "openedContainer":
236	          backend.play(CHEST_OPEN_SOUND);
237	          break;
238	        case "mobFed":
239	          backend.play(MOB_FED_SOUND);
240	          break;
241	        case "mobBred":
242	          backend.play(MOB_BRED_SOUND);
243	          break;
244	      }
245	    },
246	
247	    sync(state, dt) {
248	      if (!graph) return;
249	      const { player, world } = state;
250	      const fx = Math.floor(player.position.x);
251	      const fy = Math.floor(player.position.y);
252	      const fz = Math.floor(player.position.z);
253	
254	      // Footsteps from actual movement deltas (knockback and walking alike).
255	      if (!hasLastPosition) {
256	        lastX = player.position.x;
257	        lastZ = player.position.z;
258	        hasLastPosition = true;
259	      }
260	      const dx = player.position.x - lastX;
261	      const dz = player.position.z - lastZ;
262	      lastX = player.position.x;
263	      lastZ = player.position.z;
264	      if (!state.paused && !state.isDead && footsteps.tick(player.onGround, dx, dz)) {
265	        graph.backend.play(FOOTSTEP_SOUNDS[surfaceGroupUnder(state, fx, fy, fz)]);
266	      }
267	
268	      // Mining hit ticks: one per quarter of the block's hardness.
269	      if (state.mining.targetKey !== miningKey) {
270	        miningKey = state.mining.targetKey;
271	        miningStage = 0;
272	        if (miningKey) {
273	          const [bx, by, bz] = miningKey.split(",").map(Number);
274	          const block = world.get(bx, by, bz) as BlockId;
275	          miningTickSound = HIT_TICK_SOUNDS[materialGroupFor(block)];
276	          miningHardness = BREAK_HARDNESS[block] ?? 2;
277	        }
278	      }
279	      if (miningKey && state.mining.progress < miningHardness) {
280	        const stage = Math.floor((state.mining.progress / miningHardness) * MINING_TICK_STAGES);
281	        if (stage > miningStage) {

285	      }
286	
287	      // Mob ambience, frozen with the simulation while paused.
288	      if (!state.paused) {

292	        }
293	      }
294	
295	      // Music follows daylight immediately and the biome with hysteresis, so
296	      // zigzagging a chunk border doesn't whipsaw the mood.
297	      const biomeHere = world.getBiome(fx, fz);
298	      if (biomeHere === stableBiome) {

300	      } else if (biomeHere === pendingBiome) {
301	        pendingBiomeSeconds += dt;
302	        if (pendingBiomeSeconds >= BIOME_HYSTERESIS_SECONDS) stableBiome = biomeHere;
303	      } else {
304	        pendingBiome = biomeHere;
305	        pendingBiomeSeconds = 0;
306	      }
307	      graph.music.sync(dt, moodFor(state.daylight, stableBiome));
308	
309	      // Rain bed follows rain intensity; snow is silent, and it goes quiet on pause.
310	      graph.rain.setIntensity(!state.paused && state.weather.kind === "rain" ? state.weather.intensity : 0);

312	      if (ducked !== state.paused) {

314	        applyVolumes();
315	      }
316	    },
317	
318	    setSettings(next) {
319	      settings = next;
320	      applyVolumes();
321	    },
322	
323	    dispose() {
324	      disposed = true;
325	      graph?.dispose();
326	      graph = null;
327	    }
328	  };

import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { MOB_TEMPLATES } from "@/lib/game/mobs";
import type { MobKind } from "@/lib/game/types";
import { MATERIAL_GROUPS } from "./materials";
import {
  BREAK_SOUNDS,
  DEATH_SOUND,
  EAT_SOUND,
  FOOTSTEP_SOUNDS,
  HIT_TICK_SOUNDS,
  HURT_SOUND,
  JUMP_SOUND,
  LAND_SOUND,
  MOB_AMBIENT_SOUNDS,
  MOB_ATTACK_SOUNDS,
  MOB_HIT_SOUND,
  PLACE_SOUNDS,
  RESPAWN_SOUND,
  type SoundDef
} from "./soundParams";

const MOB_KINDS = Object.keys(MOB_TEMPLATES) as MobKind[];

const SINGLES: Record<string, SoundDef> = {
  jump: JUMP_SOUND,
  land: LAND_SOUND,
  hurt: HURT_SOUND,
  eat: EAT_SOUND,
  mobHit: MOB_HIT_SOUND,
  death: DEATH_SOUND,
  respawn: RESPAWN_SOUND
};

function expectWellFormed(name: string, def: SoundDef): void {
  expect(def.params.length).toBe(21);
  for (const value of def.params) {
    if (value !== undefined) expect(Number.isFinite(value)).toBe(true);
  }
  const volume = def.params[0];
  expect(volume).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(volume).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1.5);
  if (def.minRetriggerMs !== undefined) expect(def.minRetriggerMs).toBeGreaterThan(0);
}

describe("sound tables", () => {
  test("every material group has break, place, footstep, and hit-tick sounds", () => {
    for (const group of MATERIAL_GROUPS) {
      expectWellFormed(`break:${group}`, BREAK_SOUNDS[group]);
      expectWellFormed(`place:${group}`, PLACE_SOUNDS[group]);
      expectWellFormed(`footstep:${group}`, FOOTSTEP_SOUNDS[group]);
      expectWellFormed(`tick:${group}`, HIT_TICK_SOUNDS[group]);
    }
  });

  test("every mob kind has ambient and attack sounds", () => {
    expect(MOB_KINDS.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const kind of MOB_KINDS) {
      expectWellFormed(`ambient:${kind}`, MOB_AMBIENT_SOUNDS[kind]);
      expectWellFormed(`attack:${kind}`, MOB_ATTACK_SOUNDS[kind]);
    }
  });

  test("player one-shots are well formed", () => {
    for (const [name, def] of Object.entries(SINGLES)) expectWellFormed(name, def);
  });
});

102	    });

109	    writeAudioSettings(next);

120	  // Callback ref: the engine boots as soon as the canvas mount exists. A ref
121	  // callback runs during commit, where side effects and setState are legal.
122	  const attachMount = useCallback((node: HTMLDivElement | null) => {
123	    if (!node) {
124	      setCtx(null);
125	      return;
126	    }
127	    setCtx({ engine: new GameEngine({ save: readSave(SAVE_KEY) }), node });
128	  }, []);
129	
130	  // The minimap container mounts independently of the canvas; the rAF loop
131	  // below picks it up lazily once both exist.
132	  const attachMinimap = useCallback((node: HTMLDivElement | null) => {
133	    minimapNodeRef.current = node;
134	  }, []);
135	
136	  const engine = ctx?.engine ?? null;

140	  const snapshot = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getServerSnapshot);
141

147	  useEffect(() => {

151	    const created = GameRenderer.create(node);

162	    renderer.setPlayerSkin(getSkinPreset(skinIdRef.current).palette);

164	    const audio = createAudioDirector();

179	    // Autoplay policy: the AudioContext may only start inside a user gesture.
180	    const unlockAudio = () => audio.unlock();
181	    document.addEventListener("mousedown", unlockAudio);
182	    document.addEventListener("keydown", unlockAudio);
183	
184	    const autoSave = () => persistGame(gameEngine, flashMessage);
185	    const autoSaveId = window.setInterval(autoSave, AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL_MS);

188	    window.__monecraft = { engine: gameEngine, renderer, input, audio };

190	    let minimap: MinimapRenderer | null = null;

194	    // longer than one 50ms step, and a single clamped step would run the
195	    // simulation in slow motion. Bounded substeps keep sim time tracking wall
196	    // time; the cap bounds work per frame and quietly drops time beyond it
197	    // (e.g. after a background-tab stall).
198	    const MAX_STEP_SECONDS = 0.05;
199	    const MAX_SUBSTEPS = 5;
200	    let pendingSeconds = 0;
201	    const clock = () => {
202	      const now = performance.now();
203	      pendingSeconds = Math.min(pendingSeconds + (now - last) / 1000, MAX_STEP_SECONDS * MAX_SUBSTEPS);
204	      last = now;
205	
206	      let frameSeconds = 0;
207	      while (pendingSeconds > 0) {
208	        const dt = Math.min(pendingSeconds, MAX_STEP_SECONDS);
209	        gameEngine.step(dt, input.input);
210	        pendingSeconds -= dt;
211	        frameSeconds += dt;
212	      }
213	
214	      for (const event of gameEngine.consumeEvents()) {
215	        if (event.type === "died") {
216	          input.clearKeys();
217	          if (document.pointerLockElement === renderer.domElement) document.exitPointerLock();
218	        }
219	        if (event.type === "respawned") input.clearKeys();
220	        if (event.type === "attackSwung") renderer.triggerSwing();
221	        if (event.type === "openedStation" || event.type === "openedContainer") {
222	          // A furnace/chest opened the inventory from a mouse click — release the
223	          // keys and pointer lock the same way KeyI does on the DOM side.
224	          input.clearKeys();
225	          if (document.pointerLockElement === renderer.domElement) document.exitPointerLock();
226	        }
227	        if (event.type === "breakBlocked") {
228	          flashMessage("Not enough room to empty the chest");
229	        }
230	        if (event.type === "sleepDenied") {
231	          flashMessage(event.reason === "daylight" ? "You can only sleep at night" : "Monsters are nearby");
232	        }
233	        if (event.type === "pickedUp") {
234	          flashMessage(event.items.map((drop) => `+${drop.count} ${ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[drop.itemId]?.label ?? drop.itemId}`).join(", "));
235	        }
236	        renderer.handleEvent(event, gameEngine.state);
237	        audio.handleEvent(event);
238	      }
239	
240	      if (!minimap && minimapNodeRef.current) minimap = createMinimapRenderer(minimapNodeRef.current);
241	      // The minimap must read worldMeshDirty before renderer.sync clears it.
242	      minimap?.sync(gameEngine.state, now);
243	      renderer.sync(gameEngine.state, now);
244	      audio.sync(gameEngine.state, frameSeconds);
245	      renderer.render();
246	      animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(clock);
247	    };
248	    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(clock);

250	    return () => {
251	      delete window.__monecraft;
252	      canvasRef.current = null;
253	      rendererRef.current = null;
254	      minimap?.dispose();
255	      cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
256	      window.clearInterval(autoSaveId);
257	      window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", autoSave);
258	      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", unlockAudio);
259	      document.removeEventListener("keydown", unlockAudio);
260	      audioRef.current = null;
261	      audio.dispose();
262	      input.dispose();
263	      document.exitPointerLock();
264	      renderer.dispose();
265	    };
266	  }, [ctx, flashMessage]);
267	
268	  // Re-locking can legitimately reject (e.g. Chrome's cooldown right after
269	  // Escape); the player just clicks the canvas to lock again.
270	  const requestPointerLock = useCallback(() => {
271	    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
272	    if (canvas) Promise.resolve(canvas.requestPointerLock()).catch(() => {});
273	  }, []);

275	  return {

277	    attachMinimap,

279	    rendererError,

282	    capsActive: snapshot.capsActive,
283	    inventoryOpen: snapshot.inventoryOpen,
284	    inventory: snapshot.inventory,

  "file_path": "/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/david/monecraft/lib/game/render/projectileVisuals.ts",
  "content": "import * as THREE from \"three\";\nimport { renderSpritePixels } from \"@/lib/ui/spritePixels\";\nimport type { ProjectileState } from \"@/lib/game/engine/state\";\nimport { buildExtrudedSpriteGeometry } from \"./extrudedSprite\";\n\nexport type ProjectileVisuals = {\n  /** Creates/removes arrow meshes to match the projectile list and orients each along its flight. */\n  sync(projectiles: ProjectileState[]): void;\n  dispose(): void;\n};\n\n// The arrow sprite is drawn pointing up (+Y); rotate that axis onto the velocity.\nconst UP_Y = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);\nconst scratchDir = new THREE.Vector3();\nconst scratchQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();\n\n/**\n * Renders in-flight arrows. One extruded-sprite geometry and one material are\n * shared across every live arrow — only each mesh's transform differs — so the\n * pool allocates nothing per shot and frees both once on dispose().\n */\nexport function createProjectileVisuals(scene: THREE.Scene): ProjectileVisuals {\n  const geometry = buildExtrudedSpriteGeometry(renderSpritePixels(\"arrow\"));\n  const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.6, metalness: 0.1 });\n  const meshes = new Map<number, THREE.Mesh>();\n  const seen = new Set<number>();\n\n  const removeMesh = (id: number): void => {\n    const mesh = meshes.get(id);\n    if (!mesh) return;\n    scene.remove(mesh);\n    meshes.delete(id);\n  };\n\n  return {\n    sync(projectiles) {\n      seen.clear();\n      for (const p of projectiles) {\n        seen.add(p.id);\n        let mesh = meshes.get(p.id);\n        if (!mesh) {\n          mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n          meshes.set(p.id, mesh);\n          scene.add(mesh);\n        }\n        mesh.position.set(p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z);\n        if (p.velocity.lengthSq() > 1e-6) {\n          scratchDir.copy(p.velocity).normalize();\n          mesh.quaternion.copy(scratchQuat.setFromUnitVectors(UP_Y, scratchDir));\n        }\n      }\n      for (const id of meshes.keys()) {\n        if (!seen.has(id)) removeMesh(id);\n      }\n    },\n\n    dispose() {\n      for (const id of [...meshes.keys()]) removeMesh(id);\n      geometry.dispose();\n      material.dispose();\n    }\n  };\n}\n"
}

1	import type { MobKind } from "@/lib/game/types";
2	
3	/**
4	 * A single loot entry: yields a uniformly random count in [min, max], gated by
5	 * an optional drop chance (default: always). Counts are inclusive on both ends.
6	 */
7	export type MobDrop = {
8	  itemId: string;
9	  min: number;
10	  max: number;
11	  /** 0..1 probability the entry drops at all; omitted means always. */
12	  chance?: number;
13	};
14	
15	/**
16	 * What each mob drops when it dies. Hostiles yield crafting/combat materials,
17	 * passives yield materials plus raw meat. Item ids must exist in ITEM_DEFS —
18	 * mobLoot.test.ts enforces that.
19	 */
20	export const MOB_DROPS: Record<MobKind, MobDrop[]> = {
21	  sheep: [
22	    { itemId: "wool", min: 1, max: 2 },
23	    { itemId: "raw_mutton", min: 1, max: 1 }
24	  ],
25	  chicken: [
26	    { itemId: "feather", min: 0, max: 2 },
27	    { itemId: "raw_chicken", min: 1, max: 1 }
28	  ],
29	  horse: [{ itemId: "leather", min: 1, max: 2 }],
30	  zombie: [{ itemId: "rotten_flesh", min: 1, max: 2 }],
31	  skeleton: [{ itemId: "bone", min: 1, max: 2 }],
32	  spider: [{ itemId: "string", min: 0, max: 2 }]
33	};
34	
35	/** Clamps an rng sample into [0, 1) so a pathological injected rng can't over-roll. */
36	const clampUnit = (v: number): number => Math.min(1 - Number.EPSILON, Math.max(0, v));
37	
38	/**
39	 * Rolls the drop table for a mob kind. Returns one entry per item that yielded a
40	 * positive count; the engine adds each to the inventory. `rng` is injectable so
41	 * tests get deterministic counts (0 → min, ~1 → max).
42	 */
43	export function rollMobDrops(kind: MobKind, rng: () => number): Array<{ itemId: string; count: number }> {
44	  const drops: Array<{ itemId: string; count: number }> = [];
45	  for (const entry of MOB_DROPS[kind]) {
46	    if (entry.chance !== undefined && clampUnit(rng()) >= entry.chance) continue;
47	    const span = entry.max - entry.min + 1;
48	    const count = entry.min + Math.floor(clampUnit(rng()) * span);
49	    if (count > 0) drops.push({ itemId: entry.itemId, count });
50	  }
51	  return drops;
52	}
53

1	import type { MobKind } from "@/lib/game/types";
2	
3	/** Mobs farther than this are silent. */
4	export const MOB_EARSHOT = 24;
5	
6	/** Seconds between idle calls per kind (min..max, uniform). */
7	const CALL_INTERVALS: Record<MobKind, readonly [number, number]> = {
8	  sheep: [6, 14],
9	  chicken: [5, 12],
10	  horse: [8, 18],
11	  zombie: [4, 9],
12	  skeleton: [5, 11],
13	  spider: [4, 10]
14	};
15	
16	/** Structural subset of the engine's MobState — state.mobs passes directly. */
17	export type AmbientMob = {
18	  id: number;
19	  kind: MobKind;
20	  position: { x: number; z: number };
21	};
22	
23	export type AmbientCall = {
24	  kind: MobKind;
25	  /** Distance falloff 0..1. */
26	  gain: number;
27	  /** Stereo position -1..1 relative to the player's look direction. */
28	  pan: number;
29	};
30	
31	export type MobAmbienceScheduler = {
32	  /** Returns calls due this frame. The array is reused — consume immediately. */
33	  tick(dt: number, mobs: readonly AmbientMob[], playerX: number, playerZ: number, playerYaw: number): readonly AmbientCall[];
34	};
35	
36	export function createMobAmbienceScheduler(rng: () => number = Math.random): MobAmbienceScheduler {
37	  const timers = new Map<number, number>();
38	  const calls: AmbientCall[] = [];
39	
40	  const nextInterval = (kind: MobKind): number => {
41	    const [min, max] = CALL_INTERVALS[kind];
42	    return min + rng() * (max - min);
43	  };
44	
45	  return {
46	    tick(dt, mobs, playerX, playerZ, playerYaw) {
47	      calls.length = 0;
48	
49	      // Despawned mobs leave stale timers behind; sweep once the map outgrows
50	      // the population instead of allocating an id set every frame.
51	      if (timers.size > mobs.length + 8) {
52	        const alive = new Set(mobs.map((mob) => mob.id));
53	        for (const id of timers.keys()) if (!alive.has(id)) timers.delete(id);
54	      }
55	
56	      const rightX = Math.cos(playerYaw);
57	      const rightZ = -Math.sin(playerYaw);
58	
59	      for (const mob of mobs) {
60	        const dx = mob.position.x - playerX;
61	        const dz = mob.position.z - playerZ;
62	        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
63	        if (dist > MOB_EARSHOT) continue;
64	
65	        const timer = timers.get(mob.id);
66	        if (timer === undefined) {
67	          // First sighting: start a full randomized interval so a spawn wave
68	          // doesn't open with a chorus.
69	          timers.set(mob.id, nextInterval(mob.kind));
70	          continue;
71	        }
72	        const remaining = timer - dt;
73	        if (remaining > 0) {
74	          timers.set(mob.id, remaining);
75	          continue;
76	        }
77	        timers.set(mob.id, nextInterval(mob.kind));
78	
79	        const falloff = 1 - dist / MOB_EARSHOT;
80	        const pan = dist > 0.001 ? Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (dx * rightX + dz * rightZ) / dist)) : 0;
81	        calls.push({ kind: mob.kind, gain: falloff * falloff, pan });
82	      }
83	      return calls;
84	    }
85	  };
86	}
87

40	export function tryInteractBlock(state: GameState, emit: EmitGameEvent): boolean {
41	  const { world, player } = state;
42	  scratchEye.set(player.position.x, player.position.y + EYE_HEIGHT, player.position.z);
43	  lookDirection(player.yaw, player.pitch, scratchDir);
44	  const result = voxelRaycast(world, scratchEye, scratchDir, MINE_REACH);
45	  if (!result) return false;
46	
47	  const block = world.get(result.hit.x, result.hit.y, result.hit.z) as BlockId;
48	  const kind = INTERACTIVE_BLOCKS[block];
49	  if (!kind) return false;
50	
51	  if (kind === "bed") return interactBed(state, emit, result.hit.x, result.hit.y, result.hit.z);
52	  if (kind === "furnace") return interactFurnace(state, emit);
53	  if (kind === "chest") return interactChest(state, emit, result.hit.x, result.hit.y, result.hit.z);
54	  return false;
55	}

57	/** Opens the chest at (x,y,z) in the inventory panel, creating its (lazy) empty store. */
58	function interactChest(state: GameState, emit: EmitGameEvent, x: number, y: number, z: number): boolean {
59	  const idx = state.world.index(x, y, z);
60	  if (!state.containers.has(idx)) {
61	    state.containers.set(
62	      idx,
63	      Array.from({ length: CHEST_SLOTS }, () => createEmptySlot())
64	    );
65	  }

67	  fillDungeonChestIfUnlooted(state, idx);

69	  state.inventoryOpen = true;
70	  emit({ type: "openedContainer" });
71	  return true;
72	}

93	  if (mob.ageTimer > 0 || mob.fedTimer > 0) return false; // babies and already-in-love animals decline
94	
95	  state.inventory = adjustSlotCount(state.inventory, slot.id, -1, state.selectedSlot) ?? state.inventory;
96	  mob.fedTimer = BREED_FED_WINDOW_SECONDS;
97	  emit({ type: "mobFed", kind: mob.kind });

99	}

126	}

161	  state.inventory = adjustSlotCount(state.inventory, slot.id, -1, state.selectedSlot) ?? state.inventory;
162	  state.worldMeshDirty = true;
163	  emit({ type: "plantedSeed" });

type DeathScreenProps = {
  seconds: number;
  onRespawn: () => void;
};

/** The Minecraft death screen: red-tinted overlay, big title, respawn button. */
export default function DeathScreen({ seconds, onRespawn }: DeathScreenProps) {
  if (seconds <= 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="death-overlay">
      <div className="death-content">
        <div className="death-title">You Died!</div>
        <div className="death-sub">Respawning in {seconds}…</div>
        <button className="mc-button" onClick={onRespawn}>
          Respawn
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { MobModel } from "@/lib/game/types";

export function createMobModel(
  bodyColor: number,
  headColor: number,
  legColor: number,
  eyeColor: number,
  detailColor: number,
  bodySize: [number, number, number],
  headSize: [number, number, number]
): MobModel {
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  const materials = [
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: bodyColor, roughness: 0.86, metalness: 0.02 }),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: headColor, roughness: 0.84, metalness: 0.02 }),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: legColor, roughness: 0.9, metalness: 0.02 }),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: eyeColor, roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.05, emissive: new THREE.Color(eyeColor).multiplyScalar(0.15) }),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: detailColor, roughness: 0.82, metalness: 0.02 })
  ];

  const bodyGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(bodySize[0], bodySize[1], bodySize[2]);
  const headGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(headSize[0], headSize[1], headSize[2]);
  const legGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(Math.max(0.12, bodySize[0] * 0.2), Math.max(0.3, bodySize[1] * 0.56), Math.max(0.12, bodySize[2] * 0.2));
  const eyeGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(Math.max(0.05, headSize[0] * 0.13), Math.max(0.05, headSize[1] * 0.13), Math.max(0.03, headSize[2] * 0.1));

  const body = new THREE.Mesh(bodyGeo, materials[0]);
  body.position.y = bodySize[1] * 0.5;

  const head = new THREE.Mesh(headGeo, materials[1]);
  head.position.set(0, bodySize[1] * 0.88, bodySize[2] * 0.45);

  const eyeL = new THREE.Mesh(eyeGeo, materials[3]);
  eyeL.position.set(-headSize[0] * 0.2, head.position.y + headSize[1] * 0.05, head.position.z + headSize[2] * 0.47);
  const eyeR = new THREE.Mesh(eyeGeo, materials[3]);
  eyeR.position.set(headSize[0] * 0.2, head.position.y + headSize[1] * 0.05, head.position.z + headSize[2] * 0.47);

  const snoutGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(headSize[0] * 0.5, headSize[1] * 0.33, headSize[2] * 0.36);
  const snout = new THREE.Mesh(snoutGeo, materials[4]);
  snout.position.set(0, head.position.y - headSize[1] * 0.1, head.position.z + headSize[2] * 0.62);

/**
 * Headless simulation tests: the engine boots a real generated world and runs
 * real frames without React, Three.js rendering, or a DOM.

function mulberry32(seed: number): () => number {
  let t = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    t += 0x6d2b79f5;
    let r = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), 1 | t);
    r ^= r + Math.imul(r ^ (r >>> 7), 61 | r);
    return ((r ^ (r >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

function makeEngine(save: ReturnType<GameEngine["serialize"]> | null = null): GameEngine {
  return new GameEngine({ save, seed: 1337, rng: mulberry32(42), worldSize: { x: 64, y: 150, z: 64 } });
}

function input(overrides: Partial<{ keys: string[]; capsActive: boolean; leftMouseHeld: boolean; pointerLocked: boolean }> = {}): FrameInput {

    keys: new Set(overrides.keys ?? []),
    capsActive: overrides.capsActive ?? false,
    leftMouseHeld: overrides.leftMouseHeld ?? false,

14	} from "@/lib/game/config";

20	// Scratch vectors — per-frame tick over every mob must not allocate.
21	const UP = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
22	const scratchToPlayer = new THREE.Vector3();
23	const scratchToPlayer3D = new THREE.Vector3();
24	const scratchMobEye = new THREE.Vector3();
25	const scratchPlayerAim = new THREE.Vector3();

27	const scratchAim = new THREE.Vector3();

29	/**
30	 * A ranged mob looses an arrow from its eye toward the player's chest, leading a
31	 * moving target by a fraction of the arrow's travel time. The arrow is not
32	 * player-owned, so it only ever hits the player (never the firer or other mobs).
33	 */
34	function fireMobArrow(state: GameState, mob: MobState, damage: number, speed: number, emit: EmitGameEvent): void {
35	  const { player } = state;
36	  const eyeY = mob.position.y + mob.halfHeight * 0.7;
37	  const dist = Math.hypot(player.position.x - mob.position.x, player.position.z - mob.position.z);
38	  const lead = (dist / speed) * SKELETON_LEAD_FACTOR;
39	  scratchAim.set(
40	    player.position.x + player.velocity.x * lead - mob.position.x,
41	    player.position.y + 0.9 - eyeY,
42	    player.position.z + player.velocity.z * lead - mob.position.z
43	  );
44	  spawnArrow(state, mob.position.x, eyeY, mob.position.z, scratchAim, {
45	    speed,
46	    damage,
47	    knockback: MOB_ARROW_KNOCKBACK,
48	    fromPlayer: false,
49	    ttl: ARROW_TTL
50	  });
51	  emit({ type: "mobAttacked", kind: mob.kind });
52	}
53

55	  surfaceYAt: SurfaceYAtFn;
56	  applyDamage: (amount: number) => void;
57	  removeMobAt: (index: number) => void;
58	  rng: () => number;
59	  emit: EmitGameEvent;
60	};
61	
62	export function tickMobs(state: GameState, dt: number, deps: MobTickDeps): void {
63	  const { world, daylight, mobs, isDead } = state;
64	  const playerPosition = state.player.position;
65	  const playerVelocity = state.player.velocity;
66	  const deadIndices: number[] = [];
67	
68	  for (let i = 0; i < mobs.length; i += 1) {
69	    const mob = mobs[i];
70	    mob.attackTimer -= dt;
71	    mob.turnTimer -= dt;
72	    const activeHostile = mob.hostile && (mob.kind !== "spider" || daylight < SPIDER_AGGRO_BELOW_DAYLIGHT);
73	
74	    scratchToPlayer.copy(playerPosition).sub(mob.position).setY(0);
75	    const distanceToPlayer = scratchToPlayer.length();
76	    scratchToPlayer3D.copy(playerPosition).sub(mob.position);
77	    const attackDistance = scratchToPlayer3D.length();
78	    const verticalGap = Math.abs(scratchToPlayer3D.y);
79	    let moveSpeed = mob.speed;
80	    const isRanged = MOB_TEMPLATES[mob.kind].ranged === true;
81	    let moveSign = 1;
82	
83	    if (activeHostile && distanceToPlayer < mob.detectRange) {
84	      if (distanceToPlayer > 0.001) mob.direction.lerp(scratchToPlayer.normalize(), 0.2).normalize();
85	      moveSpeed *= 1.15;
86	      // Ranged mobs kite: back off when too close, hold inside the standoff band.
87	      if (isRanged) {
88	        if (distanceToPlayer < SKELETON_STANDOFF_MIN) moveSign = -1;
89	        else if (distanceToPlayer <= SKELETON_STANDOFF_MAX) moveSign = 0;
90	      }
91	    } else if (!mob.hostile && distanceToPlayer < 4.2) {
92	      if (distanceToPlayer > 0.001) mob.direction.lerp(scratchToPlayer.normalize().multiplyScalar(-1), 0.2).normalize();
93	      moveSpeed *= 1.15;
94	    } else if (mob.turnTimer <= 0) {
95	      mob.direction.applyAxisAngle(UP, (deps.rng() - 0.5) * Math.PI).normalize();
96	      mob.turnTimer = 1.5 + deps.rng() * 4;
97	    }
98	    mob.moveSpeed = moveSpeed;
99	
100	    let nx = mob.position.x + mob.direction.x * moveSpeed * dt * moveSign;
101	    let nz = mob.position.z + mob.direction.z * moveSpeed * dt * moveSign;
102	
103	    if (nx < 2 || nz < 2 || nx > world.sizeX - 2 || nz > world.sizeZ - 2) {
104	      mob.direction.multiplyScalar(-1);
105	      nx = mob.position.x + mob.direction.x * moveSpeed * dt * moveSign;
106	      nz = mob.position.z + mob.direction.z * moveSpeed * dt * moveSign;
107	      mob.turnTimer = 1;
108	    }
109	
110	    const ground = deps.surfaceYAt(nx, nz);
111	    mob.position.set(nx, ground + mob.halfHeight, nz);
112	    mob.yaw = Math.atan2(mob.direction.x, mob.direction.z);
113	
114	    // Ranged mobs shoot from anywhere in their detect range; melee mobs must be adjacent.
115	    const meleeReady = activeHostile && attackDistance < 4 && verticalGap < 1.6;
116	    const fireReady = isRanged && activeHostile && attackDistance < mob.detectRange && verticalGap < SKELETON_FIRE_VGAP;
117	
118	    let hasLineOfSight = true;
119	    if (meleeReady || fireReady) {
120	      scratchMobEye.set(mob.position.x, mob.position.y + mob.halfHeight * 0.35, mob.position.z);
121	      scratchPlayerAim.set(playerPosition.x, playerPosition.y + 0.9, playerPosition.z);
122	      scratchRay.copy(scratchPlayerAim).sub(scratchMobEye);
123	      if (scratchRay.lengthSq() > 1e-6) {
124	        const hit = voxelRaycast(world, scratchMobEye, scratchRay.normalize(), attackDistance + 0.5);
125	        hasLineOfSight = hit === null;
126	      }
127	    }
128	
129	    // !isDead: mobs keep ticking through the respawn countdown, but attacking a
130	    // corpse should neither sound nor re-arm the attack cooldown.
131	    if (!isDead && (meleeReady || fireReady) && hasLineOfSight && mob.attackTimer <= 0) {
132	      if (fireReady) {
133	        fireMobArrow(state, mob, SKELETON_ARROW_DAMAGE, SKELETON_ARROW_SPEED, deps.emit);
134	      } else {
135	        deps.emit({ type: "mobAttacked", kind: mob.kind });
136	        deps.applyDamage(mob.attackDamage);
137	        if (distanceToPlayer > 0.001) {
138	          scratchToPlayer.normalize().multiplyScalar(4.2);
139	          playerVelocity.x += scratchToPlayer.x;
140	          playerVelocity.z += scratchToPlayer.z;
141	          playerVelocity.y = Math.max(playerVelocity.y, 3.4);
142	        }
143	      }
144	      mob.attackTimer = mob.attackCooldown;
145	    }
146	
147	    // Zombies and skeletons burn in broad daylight.
148	    if (mob.hostile && mob.kind !== "spider" && daylight > HOSTILE_BURN_ABOVE_DAYLIGHT) {
149	      mob.hp -= dt * 0.8;
150	    }
151	
152	    if (mob.hp <= 0) deadIndices.push(i);
153	  }
154	
155	  for (let i = deadIndices.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) deps.removeMobAt(deadIndices[i]);
156	}
157

Refuses (keeping the totem) when a boss already\n   * walks. function run(engine: GameEngine, seconds: number, frame: FrameInput = input()): void {
  const dt = 1 / 60;
  for (let t = 0; t < seconds; t += dt) engine.step(dt, frame);
}

/**
 * The world boots at dawn (daylight 0.05), so the initial hostiles aggro
 * immediately. Tests about other mechanics clear them and move to midday.
 */
function calmDaytime(engine: GameEngine): void {
  engine.state.mobs = engine.state.mobs.filter((mob) => !mob.hostile);
  engine.state.dayClock = 60;
}

  test("killing a baby drops nothing", () => {
    const engine = new GameEngine({ seed: 1337, rng: () => 0, worldSize: { x: 64, y: 150, z: 64 } });
    calmDaytime(engine);
    run(engine, 1);
    engine.state.player.yaw = 0;
    engine.state.player.pitch = 0;
    const id = pushSheepAhead(engine, 50); // a baby (ageTimer > 0)
    const baby = engine.state.mobs.find((mob) => mob.id === id)!;
    baby.hp = 1; // one fist hit kills it
    const before = countsById(engine.state.inventory);
    engine.consumeEvents();
    engine.dispatch({ type: "attack" });
    const events = engine.consumeEvents();
    expect(engine.state.mobs.some((mob) => mob.id === id)).toBe(false); // died
    expect(events.some((event) => event.type === "pickedUp")).toBe(false); // no loot toast for a baby
    const after = countsById(engine.state.inventory);
    expect(after.get("wool") ?? 0).toBe(before.get("wool") ?? 0);
    expect(after.get("raw_mutton") ?? 0).toBe(before.get("raw_mutton") ?? 0);
  });
